Begin T_ScCrea_ArmorCenturionEquip
; Since we can't have "smart" leveled lists, such as "one sword or one crossbow and twenty bolts",
; this script manages the centurion's equipment based on his leveled list result. That way, a single
; creature is needed to provide for a variety of random armor centurion warriors, with crossbow and
; bolts, darts, one-handed weapon and shield, or two-handed weapons without shield.

short control		; determines how the script will work

if ( ondeath == 1 )
	set control to 5 ; avoids the "Golena Sadri Bug"...
endif

if ( control >= 5 )
	return

elseif ( control == 4 ) ; dwemer bot fights with darts
	if ( getitemcount "T_Dwe_Regular_Dart_01" < 10 )
		additem "T_Dwe_Regular_Dart_01" 10
	endif

elseif ( control == 3 ) ; dwemer bot is equipped with crossbow
	if ( getitemcount "T_Dwe_Regular_Bolt_01" < 10 )
		additem "T_Dwe_Regular_Bolt_01" 10
	endif

elseif ( control == 2 ) ; dwemer bot is equipped with 2H weapon
	set control to 5

elseif ( control == 1 ) ; dwemer bot is equipped with 1H weapon
	set control to ( Player->GetLevel + 50 )
	if ( control > Random100 )
		additem "T_Dwe_Regular_ShieldTower_01" 1
		equip "T_Dwe_Regular_ShieldTower_01"
	else
		additem "dwemer_shield" 1
		equip "dwemer_shield"
	endif
	set control to 5

elseif ( control == 0 )
; Stupid "GetWeaponType" function being, well, not functional, I have no choice but to use that ugly
; prescriptive code rather than the elegant, simple descriptive code that should have theoretically
; been possible if Bethesda didn't hate modders. Grr. I'm bitter.
; Anyway, this script is simply impossible to do without using a fucking list of all the possible
; weapons the centurion can have, which means the script has to be updated if the leveled list is.

	if ( GetItemCount "dwarven battle axe" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount "dwarven claymore" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount "dwarven halberd" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount "dwarven mace" > 0 )
		set control to 1
	elseif ( GetItemCount "dwarven shortsword" > 0 )
		set control to 1
	elseif ( GetItemCount "dwarven spear" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount "dwarven war axe" > 0 )
		set control to 1
	elseif ( GetItemCount "dwarven warhammer" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount "dwemer jinksword" > 0 )
		set control to 1
	elseif ( GetItemCount "T_Dwe_Regular_Broadsword_01" > 0 )
		set control to 1
	elseif ( GetItemCount "T_Dwe_Regular_Dagger_01" > 0 )
		set control to 1
	elseif ( GetItemCount "T_Dwe_Regular_Longspear_01" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount "T_Dwe_Regular_Longsword_01" > 0 )
		set control to 1
	elseif ( GetItemCount "T_Dwe_Regular_Staff_01" > 0 )
		set control to 2
	elseif ( GetItemCount "T_Dwe_Regular_Dart_01" > 0 )
		additem "T_Dwe_Regular_Dart_01" 9
		set control to 4
	elseif ( GetItemCount "T_Dwe_Regular_Dart_Shock" > 0 )
		additem "T_Dwe_Regular_Dart_Shock" 9
		set control to 4
	elseif ( GetItemCount "T_Dwe_Regular_CrossbowFix_01" > 0 )
		set control to 3
	endif

endif

End

begin T_ScCrea_ButterflyCyr_01 ; Butterflies should only appear at daytime

	SetDelete 1 ; Remove the creature permanently after it's been collected
	return
endif

	SetHealth 0
	Disable

	PlaySoundVP, "Item Ingredient Up", 0.75, 1.0
	MessageBox "2 Red Fan Butterfly Wings have been added to your inventory."

		Disable
		Set state to 2
	elseif (GameHour < 7 ) ; night. Needs to be checked here aswell in case the creature is loaded at night
		Disable
		Set state to 2

Begin T_ScCrea_EyestarHarvest

; An attempt to make a script that lets one harvest eyestars for parts. Eyestars were first meant to be creatures, but since 
; they lack the required animations, this is the way to still make them dangerous and potentially useful, i.e., elements of
; gameplay rather than mere eyestarcandy.


short button		; for the messagebox stuff
short chance	; for random stuff
short state		; generic control var stuff


if ( OnActivate )
	set chance to ( Player->GetLuck )						; computes the player's chance at harvesting harmlessly
	set chance to ( chance + Player->GetAlchemy )		; by making the sum of his luck, his knowledge of harvesting
	set chance to ( chance + Player->GetAgility )		; ingredients, and his manual dexterity.
	set chance to ( chance / 4 )								; But let's not get the result too high.
	MessageBox "Do you want to attempt to harvest this eyestar for its eye?" "Yes" "No"
	set state to 1
endif

if ( state == 0 )			; no need to process all the rest 99.97% of the time.
	return
endif

if ( state == 1 )
	set button to GetButtonPressed
	if ( button == -1 )
		return
	elseif ( button == 0 )
		if ( chance > random100 )			; rewards high scores, they're more likely to be higher than random100.
			set state to 5						; directly moves on to last stage.
			set button to 30					; uses var button to "store" success
			return
		else
			set chance to ( chance * 1.2 )	; let's address the case where full success was not missed by much.
			if ( chance > random100 )
				set state to 4
				set button to 20
				return
			else
				set chance to ( chance * 1.2 )
				if ( chance > random100 )
					set state to 3
					set button to 10
					return
				else
					set state to 2
					set button to -10
					return
				endif
			endif
		endif
	elseif ( button == 1 )						; for those who had a pang of conscience and let the poor thingie alone.
		set state to 0
	endif
endif

if ( state == 2 )									; only those who miserably failed to harvest will get this.
	Player->ModCurrentHealth -5
	if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
		if ( Random100 >= 85 )
			Player->AddSpell "T_Dis_WitchesPox"
		endif
	endif
	set state to 3								; moves on to next stage
endif

if ( state == 3 )									; only those who failed to harvest will get this.
	player->ModCurrentHealth -5
	if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
		if ( random100 >= 75 )
			Player->AddSpell "T_Dis_ChronDiasis"
		endif
	endif
	set state to 4								; moves on to next stage
endif

if ( state == 4 )									; you get infected; disease severity depends on how bad you were.
	player->ModCurrentHealth -5
	if ( chance < 36 )
		if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
			if ( random100 >= 75 )
				Player->AddSpell "T_Dis_CalironsCurse"
				Player->AddSpell "T_Dis_Wizardfever"
			endif
		endif
	elseif ( chance < 48 )
		if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
			if ( random100 >= 65 )
				Player->AddSpell "T_Dis_CalironsCurse"
			endif
		endif
	else
		if ( Player->GetResistDisease < Random 100 )
			if ( Random100 >= 65 )
				Player->AddSpell "T_Dis_Wizardfever"
			endif
		endif
	endif
	set state to 5
endif

if ( state == 5 )													; last stage
	if ( button >= 20 )
		Player->AddItem "T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01" 1
		RemoveItem "T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01" 1
		MessageBox "You successfully extracted the Star's Eye."
	elseif ( button >= random 30 )
		Player->AddItem "T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01" 1
		RemoveItem "T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01" 1
		MessageBox "You managed to extract the Star's Eye."
	else
		MessageBox "Your attempt was a failure, and the eyestar lashed at you."
	endif
	set state to -10
	disable													; then disappear
	return
endif


if ( GetItemCount "T_IngCrea_Eyestar_01" )					; once the container respawns its eye,
	enable														; makes it reappear, too. Respawn, really.
	set state to 0												; and goes back to normal.
endif

End

set RandNum to ( RandNum - 150 )
set NewScale to ( 1 + ( RandNum / 1000 ) )
setScale NewScale

set DoOnce to 1

	SetFight 0

	set dormant to 3
endif

	if ( dormant == 3 )

			SetFight 100
			startcombat, player
			set dormant to 2
		endif
	endif
endif


end

begin T_ScCrea_VentWorm

; Idle = Idle loop
; Idle2 = Closing
; Idle3 = Closed
; Idle4 = Opening
; Death1 = Looted

float timer
short looted
short close

DontSaveObject

if ( MenuMode )
    return
endif

if ( timer > 0 )
    set timer to ( timer - GetSecondsPassed )
    return
endif

; close when player gets too close
if ( close == 1 )
    ; MessageBox "Player is too close, do [LoopGroup Idle2 0 1]"
     PlaySound3D "Kwama forager slither"
    LoopGroup Idle2 0 1
    set timer to 10
    set close to 2
    return
endif

; open when player is far away
if ( GetDistance Player >= 250 )
    if ( close > 0 )
        ; MessageBox "Far Enough Away, do [LoopGroup Idle4 0 1]"
     PlaySound3D "Kwama forager slither"
        LoopGroup Idle4 0 1
        set close to 0
    endif
    if ( close < 0 )
        ; MessageBox "Finished Opening, do [PlayGroup Idle]"
     PlaySound3D "Kwama forager slither"
        PlayGroup Idle
        set close to -1
    endif
    return
endif

if ( close == 0 )
    set close to 1
endif

end

Begin T_ScCrea_WereboarWilderness

;Create a duplicate of this script, if you want your wereboar to turn into a specific npc

short transformed; whether the creature turned into human
short transformationEffectSpawned
short isNight
short isDead
float time
float xPos
float yPos
float zPos
float zRot

if ( PCWerewolf == 0 )
	if ( player->GetSpell "T_Dis_WereboarBlood" == 1 )
		if ( scriptRunning "T_ScTrans_WereCheck" == 0 )
			startScript "T_ScTrans_WereCheck"
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( menumode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( transformed == 1 )
	setDelete 1
	return
endif

if ( isDead == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( onDeath == 1 )
	set isDead to 1
	return
endif

set isNight to 1 ;nighttime by default
if ( gameHour < 21 ) ; daytime
	if ( gameHour > 6 )
		set isNight to 0
	endif
endif	

if ( isNight == 0 ) ; daytime
	set time to ( time + GetSecondsPassed )	

	;place the effect
	if ( transformationEffectSpawned == 0 )
		set xPos to ( getPos, X )
		set yPos to ( getPos, Y )
		set zPos to ( getPos, Z )
		Placeitem, "T_Glb_Var_WereboarMorph", xPos, yPos, zPos, 0
		AIWAnder 0, 0, 0, 100, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		set transformationEffectSpawned to 1
	endif

	;change to human
	If ( time >= 1 )
		set xPos to ( getPos, X )
		set yPos to ( getPos, Y )
		set zPos to ( getPos, Z )
		set zRot to ( ( ( getAngle, Z ) + 90 ) * 60 )
		disable
		Placeitem, "T_Glb_LycWereboar", xPos, yPos, zPos, zRot 
		set transformed to 1
	endif
endif

End

		addSpell "Wither"

begin T_ScGlobal_NineholesCheckWin

;-------------
; One of the scripts originally created for the "Nine-holes" mod
; by Dillon241. Ported to Tamriel Data and edited with author's permission.
;-------------

short wager
short messageOn
short button
short WinLose
short tracker

; Delay setting the T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn to 0 until after the player clicks Ok
; so that they can see the last move (pins disappear when T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn is 0)
if ( messageOn == 1 )
	set button to GetButtonPressed
	if ( button != -1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn to 0 ; so that the pins disappear

		if ( WinLose == 1 ) ; player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; betting game is ongoing
				set T_Glob_NineholesGameState to 30
			elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode == 1 ) ; practice game is ongoing
				set T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode to 0
			endif
		else ; player lost
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; betting game is ongoing
				set T_Glob_NineholesGameState to 40 ; player lost a betting game
			elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode == 1 ) ; practice game is ongoing
				set T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode to 0
			endif
		endif

		set messageOn to 0
		set button to -1
		set WinLose to 0
		set tracker to 0
		StopScript "T_ScGlobal_NineholesCheckWin"
	endif
	return
endif

; row 1 win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a
		endif
	endif
endif

; row 2 win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a
		endif
	endif
endif

; row 3 win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a
		endif
	endif
endif

; column A win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a
		endif
	endif
endif

; column B win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b
		endif
	endif
endif

; column C win
if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c > 0 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c == T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c )
			set tracker to T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( tracker == 1 )
	if ( tracker == T_Glob_NineholesPlayerColor )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 )
			MessageBox "You won the game as Red! This ends the challenge. Talk to the opponent for a rematch or conclusion." "Ok"
		else
			MessageBox "You won the practice round as Red!" "Ok"
		endif
		set WinLose to 1
	else
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 )
			MessageBox "Your opponent, as Red, beat you. You can play again for a rematch." "Ok"
		else
			MessageBox "You lost the practice round as White!" "Ok"
		endif
		set WinLose to 0
	endif
	set messageOn to 1
elseif ( tracker == 2 )
	if ( tracker == T_Glob_NineholesPlayerColor )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 )
			MessageBox "You won the game as White! This ends the challenge. Talk to the opponent for a rematch or conclusion." "Ok"
		else
			MessageBox "You won the practice round as White!" "Ok"
		endif
		set WinLose to 1
	else
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 )
			MessageBox "Your opponent, as White, beat you. You can play again for a rematch." "Ok"
		else
			MessageBox "You lost the practice round as Red!" "Ok"
		endif
		set WinLose to 0
	endif
	set messageOn to 1
endif

if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; betting game is ongoing
	if ( WinLose == 1 ) ; player won
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; player wins bet back plus NPC's bet (double the bet)
			set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet * 2 )
			MessageBox "%G Gold has been added to your inventory." wager
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				player->AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				player->AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			PlaySound "Item Gold Up"
		endif
	endif
endif

; MessageBox with buttons was not called so this script can stop
if ( messageOn != 1 )
	StopScript "T_ScGlobal_NineholesCheckWin"
endif

end

begin T_ScGlobal_NineholesMovePin

;-------------
; One of the scripts originally created for the "Nine-holes" mod
; by Dillon241. Ported to Tamriel Data and edited with author's permission.
;-------------

; Accumulated value of pins placed on the board so far. One player
; has value 1, another has 2, so if both have to place 3 pins at most,
; then the value should reach 1+1+1+2+2+2=3+6=9 to reach the 2nd game stage
short whendone

if ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 1 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 2 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 3 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 4 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 5 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 6 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 7 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 8 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c to 0
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin == 9 )
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c to 0
endif

set whendone to ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a )
set whendone to ( whendone + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b )
set whendone to ( whendone + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c )
set whendone to ( whendone + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c + T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c )
if ( whendone >= 9 ) ; Have both players placed all their initial pins
	set T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin to -1
else
	set T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin to 0
endif

set T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn to ( 3 - T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn )

PlaySound "T_SndObj_TileUp"

StartScript "T_ScGlobal_NineholesCheckWin"

StopScript "T_ScGlobal_NineholesMovePin"

end

Begin T_ScGlobal_PassTime

;Starting this script emulates the passage of time,
;hour by hour, day by day, month by month, ...
;the amount of hours to pass is first given in
;global short T_Glob_PassTimeHours

short count

if ( count == 0 )
	FadeOut 0.35
	DisablePlayerControls
	set count to 1
endif

If ( count <= T_Glob_PassTimeHours )
	if ( GameHour >= 23 )
		set GameHour to ( GameHour - 23 )
		set DaysPassed to ( DaysPassed + 1 )
		if ( Day == 30 )
			if ( Month == 10 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 8 )
				set Day to 1
				elseif ( Month == 5 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 3 )
				set Day to 1
			else
				set Day to ( Day + 1 )
			endif
		elseif ( Day == 31 )
			if ( Month == 11 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 9 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 7 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 6 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 4 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 2 )
				set Day to 1
			elseif ( Month == 0 )
				set Day to 1
			else
				set Day to ( Day + 1 )
			endif
		elseif ( Day == 28 )
			if ( Month == 1 )
				set Day to 1
			else
				set Day to ( Day + 1 )
			endif
		else
			set Day to ( Day + 1 )
		endif
		if ( Day == 1 )
			if ( Month == 11 )
				set Month to 0
				set Year to ( Year + 1 )
			else
				set Month to ( Month + 1 )
			endif
		endif
	else
		set GameHour to ( GameHour + 1 )
	endif
	set count to ( count + 1 )
	return
Endif

Set T_Glob_PassTimeHours to 0
Set count to 0
FadeIn 0.35
EnablePlayerControls
StopScript "T_ScGlobal_PassTime"

End

Begin T_ScGlobal_SulphurPool

; Global script for dealing equipment damage while the player is standing in sulphur pools
;
; Disintegrate effects are applied once every second.
;
; Disintegrate armor will crash the game if the player removes the piece of equipment
; it is affecting while the effect is active
;
; Disintegrate Weapon thankfully does not have this issue

float timer
short control

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )

if ( timer >= 1 )
	set timer to 0
	set control to 0
	StopScript T_ScGlobal_SulphurPool
	Return
elseif ( control )
	return
endif

set control to 1

if ( MWSE_BUILD == 0 )
	player->AddItem T_Var_Sulphur_Armor 1
endif
player->Equip T_Var_Sulphur_Armor

if ( player->GetWeaponDrawn )
	if ( MWSE_BUILD == 0 )
		player->AddItem T_Var_Sulphur_Weapon 1
	endif
	player->Equip T_Var_Sulphur_Weapon
endif

player->StopSound Drink

End

	if ( safeguard == 2 )
		StopScript T_ScNews_Bellman_Add

		set safeguard to ( safeguard + 1 )
	endif

	; which tracker are we updating?
	set numbersimple to number

		set numbersimple to ( numbersimple - 24 )

Begin T_ScNews_Bellman_Paper

short OnPCAdd
short doOnce
short resetDay

; README
; this rather opaque script ensures that the game treats papers that were placed by hand in the CS different
; from papers that were spawned by script from the T_News_Bellman_Spawner_X objects. The way that
; this is achieved is by using CellChanged - papers placed by hand encounter a CellChanged the first time
; they are loaded, while papers spawned by the Spawner first appear in the game world *after* CellChanged
; has been detected, and passed, on the Spawner object. This means that a spawned paper progresses
; through doOnce==0, ==1 and ==2, while a placed paper is intercepted on the second frame by CellChanged,
; and has its doOnce variable set to -1.

if ( doOnce == -1 )
    Return
endif

if ( CellChanged )
	if ( doOnce == 2 )
		; papers that are at this stage have successfully passed through the setup once, 
		; without being interrupted by CellChanged. This means that they were spawned
		; rather than hand-placed, and as such they get disabled and deleted after two days.
		if ( resetDay <= DaysPassed )
			Disable
			set doOnce to 3
		endif
	else
		; papers that did not proceed through the entire setup are papers that were hand-placed, 
		; and here is where CellChanged interrupts the setup and renders them inert.
		set doOnce to -1
	endif
	Return
endif

if ( OnPCAdd == 1 )
	; OnPCAdd renders the script inert, and ensures the paper does not delete itself.
	set doOnce to -1
	Return
endif

if ( doOnce == 0 )
	set doOnce to 1
	; skip a frame to give CellChanged a chance to trigger
elseif ( doOnce == 1 )
	if ( GetPos Z == 0 )
		if ( GetPos Y == 0 )
			if ( GetPos X == 0 )
				; papers without coordinates are in an inventory, and are rendered inert.
				set doOnce to -1
				Return
			endif
		endif
	endif
	if ( doOnce == 1 )
		; at this stage, CellChanged has had a chance to trigger - and if it didn't,
		; it means that this paper was spawned into the cell after cell change.
		; here, we set the reset parameters that ensure the paper deletes itself
		; if not picked up within two days.
		set resetDay to ( 2 + DaysPassed )
		set doOnce to 2
	endif
elseif ( doOnce == 3 )
	SetDelete 1
	Return
endif

End

Begin T_ScNews_Compass_Add

short trackernumber
long tracker
long trackerincrease
short safeguard

if ( CellChanged == 1 )
	; delays termination by one frame - not sure if necessary,
	; but just to be safe, it's here.
	if ( safeguard == 2 )
		StopScript T_ScNews_Compass_Add
	else
		set safeguard to ( safeguard + 1 )
	endif
endif

if ( number > 0 )

	; which tracker are we updating?
	set numbersimple to number
	set trackernumber to 0
	while ( numbersimple > 24 )
		set numbersimple to ( numbersimple - 24 )
		set trackernumber to ( trackernumber + 1 )

	if ( trackernumber < 1 )

	set numbersimple to number

		set numbersimple to ( numbersimple - 24 )
		set trackernumber to ( trackernumber + 1 )

	Return
endif

	if ( CellChanged == 1 )
		if ( resetDay <= DaysPassed ) ; if two days have passed, reset and respawn.
			set doOnce to 0
		endif
	else
		Return
	endif
endif

if ( doOnce == 0 )	; if we've reset the script, fire it up.
	set doOnce to 10
	; disable the spawner
	if ( GetDisabled == 0 )
		Disable

	Return

	; only if no other script has initialized the randompicker scripts do we proceed
	if ( ScriptRunning T_Glob_News_Compass_Picker1 == 0 )

		set pick1 to ( pick1 - 100*weight1 )

Begin T_ScNews_Echo_Add

short number

short trackernumber
long tracker
long trackerincrease
short safeguard

if ( CellChanged == 1 )
	; delays termination by one frame - not sure if necessary,
	; but just to be safe, it's here.
	if ( safeguard == 2 )
		StopScript T_ScNews_Echo_Add
	else
		set safeguard to ( safeguard + 1 )
	endif
endif

if ( number > 0 )

	; which tracker are we updating?
	set numbersimple to number
	set trackernumber to 0
	while ( numbersimple > 24 )
		set numbersimple to ( numbersimple - 24 )
		set trackernumber to ( trackernumber + 1 )
	endwhile
	if ( trackernumber < 1 )
		set tracker to T_Glob_News_Echo_Tracker1

		if ( numbersimple == 23 )

Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_AnvilNineholes
; This short script allows dialogue to filtered by kingdom.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting

; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 1

; START DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; Depends on the early return due to T_Local_Khajiit! If used elsewhere, edit accordingly
set T_Glob_NineholesNpcId to ( T_Glob_NineholesNpcId + 1 )
set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId to T_Glob_NineholesNpcId
set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 1
if ( changelevel > 360 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
	if ( changelevel > 500 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 3
	elseif ( changelevel > 420 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
elseif ( changelevel > 120 )

	endif
endif

;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

;-----------------------------------------------

	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else

		set checkBlood to 1
	endif

	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model

	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1

	return

	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire

		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

	set NoHello to 0

	set NoHello to 0

	AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
	set fixHead to 1
	set NoHello to 1
endif

	if ( GetSpell "Vampire Sun Damage" == 0 )
		AddSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
		RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		set fixHead to 1
		set NoHello to 0
	endif
endif

	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1

	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 1

Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_ChorrolNineholes
; This short script allows dialogue to filtered by kingdom.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting

; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 5

; START DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; Depends on the early return due to T_Local_Khajiit! If used elsewhere, edit accordingly
set T_Glob_NineholesNpcId to ( T_Glob_NineholesNpcId + 1 )
set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId to T_Glob_NineholesNpcId
set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 1
if ( changelevel > 360 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
	if ( changelevel > 500 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 3
	elseif ( changelevel > 420 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
elseif ( changelevel > 120 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 2
	if ( changelevel > 150 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
endif
; END DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

End

short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting

; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif

Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_SancreTorNineholes
; This short script allows dialogue to filtered by kingdom.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting

; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 9

; START DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; Depends on the early return due to T_Local_Khajiit! If used elsewhere, edit accordingly
set T_Glob_NineholesNpcId to ( T_Glob_NineholesNpcId + 1 )
set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId to T_Glob_NineholesNpcId
set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 1
if ( changelevel > 360 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
	if ( changelevel > 500 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 3
	elseif ( changelevel > 420 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
elseif ( changelevel > 120 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 2
	if ( changelevel > 150 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
endif
; END DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

End

short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting

; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif

		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return

		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )

				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )

					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif

		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )

				endwhile

		endif

			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif

set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1

	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
	if ( changelevel > 500 )

Begin T_ScNpc_Cyr_SutchVamp

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short PC_Map
short Control
short ControlQ
short NoLore
short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short T_Local_NoLore
short checkBlood
short state
short fixHead

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem "ingred_vampire_dust_01" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Quarra" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Aundae" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Berne" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects "T_Vamp_Dis_Order" )
		if ( ScriptRunning "T_ScVamp_Order_PC" != 1 )
			StartScript "T_ScVamp_Order_PC"
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 150 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	elseif ( VampClan > 0 )
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

if ( GetFight >= 80 )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetWeaponDrawn )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpellReadied )
	set NoHello to 0
elseif ( GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise == 0 )
	RemoveSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
	AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
	set fixHead to 1
	set NoHello to 1
endif

if ( NoHello == 0 )
	if ( GetSpell "Vampire Sun Damage" == 0 )
		AddSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
		RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		set fixHead to 1
		set NoHello to 0
	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set PC_Map to 2

AddSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Order
AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order
AddSpell "Vampire Attributes"
AddSpell "Vampire Skills"
AddSpell "Vampire Immunities"
AddSpell "Vampire Touch"
ModRestoration 75

End

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map1HHScrip
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; This script also facilitates the treatment of Hlaalu Company Scrip as equivalent to gold,
; this is done by temporarily exchanging them for each other outside dialogue
; so no messages are displayed on the player's screen.

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
short T_Local_HHScripExchange
long ScripCount
long ScripStart
long GoldStart
long GoldEnd

if ( OnDeath )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to -1
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( GetPCSneaking )		; when PC is pickpocketing, ignore.
	elseif ( GetFatigue < 10 )	; when NPC is knocked out, ignore. <10 is for recovery animation.
	elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 0 )	; else initiate scrip exchange if PC has scrip
		if ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 > 0 )

			set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 1

			; add the topic so the merchant can be asked about it, in case player is confused
			AddTopic "Hlaalu Company scrip"

			set ScripStart to ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 )
			set GoldStart to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart

			while ( ScripCount > 0 )
				if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
					player->AddItem gold_001 10000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
					player->AddItem gold_001 1000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
					player->AddItem gold_001 100
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
					player->AddItem gold_001 10
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
					player->AddItem gold_001 1
				endif
			endwhile
			Return	; no activate now, delay one frame instead.
		endif
	endif
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 1 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 2
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 2 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 3	; skip one frame before we start checking for menumode, just to be safe.
elseif ( T_local_HHScripExchange == 2 )
	if ( MenuMode == 0 )

		set GoldEnd to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
		set GoldEnd to ( GoldEnd - ScripStart )
		set ScripCount to ( ScripStart - ( GoldStart - GoldEnd ) )

		if ( ScripCount > ScripStart )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart	; don't give the player more scrip than they had at the start, have profits be gold instead.
		endif

		while ( ScripCount > 0 )
			if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 100
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1
			endif
		endwhile
		set ScripCount to 0
		set ScripStart to 0
		set GoldStart to 0
		set GoldEnd to 0
		set T_local_HHScripExchange to 0

	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map1NineHoles
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting


; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set TR_Map to 1

; START DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; Depends on the early return due to T_Local_Khajiit! If used elsewhere, edit accordingly
set T_Glob_NineholesNpcId to ( T_Glob_NineholesNpcId + 1 )
set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId to T_Glob_NineholesNpcId
set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 1
if ( changelevel > 360 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
	if ( changelevel > 500 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 3
	elseif ( changelevel > 420 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
elseif ( changelevel > 120 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 2
	if ( changelevel > 150 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
endif
; END DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

End

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map2HHScrip
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; This script also facilitates the treatment of Hlaalu Company Scrip as equivalent to gold,
; this is done by temporarily exchanging them for each other outside dialogue
; so no messages are displayed on the player's screen.

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
short T_Local_HHScripExchange
long ScripCount
long ScripStart
long GoldStart
long GoldEnd

if ( OnDeath )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to -1
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( GetPCSneaking )		; when PC is pickpocketing, ignore.
	elseif ( GetFatigue < 10 )	; when NPC is knocked out, ignore. <10 is for recovery animation.
	elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 0 )	; else initiate scrip exchange if PC has scrip
		if ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 > 0 )

			set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 1

			; add the topic so the merchant can be asked about it, in case player is confused
			AddTopic "Hlaalu Company scrip"

			set ScripStart to ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 )
			set GoldStart to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart

			while ( ScripCount > 0 )
				if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
					player->AddItem gold_001 10000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
					player->AddItem gold_001 1000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
					player->AddItem gold_001 100
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
					player->AddItem gold_001 10
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
					player->AddItem gold_001 1
				endif
			endwhile
			Return	; no activate now, delay one frame instead.
		endif
	endif
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 1 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 2
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 2 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 3	; skip one frame
elseif ( T_local_HHScripExchange == 3 )
	if ( MenuMode == 0 )

		set GoldEnd to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
		set GoldEnd to ( GoldEnd - ScripStart )
		set ScripCount to ( ScripStart - ( GoldStart - GoldEnd ) )

		if ( ScripCount > ScripStart )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart	; don't give the player more scrip than they had at the start, have profits be gold instead.
		endif

		while ( ScripCount > 0 )
			if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 100
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1
			endif
		endwhile
		set ScripCount to 0
		set ScripStart to 0
		set GoldStart to 0
		set GoldEnd to 0
		set T_local_HHScripExchange to 0

	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set TR_Map to 2

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map2NineHoles
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting


; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set TR_Map to 2

; START DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; Depends on the early return due to T_Local_Khajiit! If used elsewhere, edit accordingly
set T_Glob_NineholesNpcId to ( T_Glob_NineholesNpcId + 1 )
set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId to T_Glob_NineholesNpcId
set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 1
if ( changelevel > 360 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
	if ( changelevel > 500 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 3
	elseif ( changelevel > 420 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
elseif ( changelevel > 120 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 2
	if ( changelevel > 150 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
endif
; END DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

End

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map3HHScrip
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; This script also facilitates the treatment of Hlaalu Company Scrip as equivalent to gold,
; this is done by temporarily exchanging them for each other outside dialogue
; so no messages are displayed on the player's screen.

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
short T_Local_HHScripExchange
long ScripCount
long ScripStart
long GoldStart
long GoldEnd

if ( OnDeath )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to -1
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( GetPCSneaking )		; when PC is pickpocketing, ignore.
	elseif ( GetFatigue < 10 )	; when NPC is knocked out, ignore. <10 is for recovery animation.
	elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 0 )	; else initiate scrip exchange if PC has scrip
		if ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 > 0 )

			set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 1

			; add the topic so the merchant can be asked about it, in case player is confused
			AddTopic "Hlaalu Company scrip"

			set ScripStart to ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 )
			set GoldStart to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart

			while ( ScripCount > 0 )
				if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
					player->AddItem gold_001 10000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
					player->AddItem gold_001 1000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
					player->AddItem gold_001 100
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
					player->AddItem gold_001 10
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
					player->AddItem gold_001 1
				endif
			endwhile
			Return	; no activate now, delay one frame instead.
		endif
	endif
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 1 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 2
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 2 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 3	; skip one frame
elseif ( T_local_HHScripExchange == 3 )
	if ( MenuMode == 0 )

		set GoldEnd to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
		set GoldEnd to ( GoldEnd - ScripStart )
		set ScripCount to ( ScripStart - ( GoldStart - GoldEnd ) )

		if ( ScripCount > ScripStart )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart	; don't give the player more scrip than they had at the start, have profits be gold instead.
		endif

		while ( ScripCount > 0 )
			if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 100
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1
			endif
		endwhile
		set ScripCount to 0
		set ScripStart to 0
		set GoldStart to 0
		set GoldEnd to 0
		set T_local_HHScripExchange to 0

	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1

	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
