Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map3NineHoles
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable,
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting


; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map4HHScrip
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; This script also facilitates the treatment of Hlaalu Company Scrip as equivalent to gold,
; this is done by temporarily exchanging them for each other outside dialogue
; so no messages are displayed on the player's screen.

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
short T_Local_HHScripExchange
long ScripCount
long ScripStart
long GoldStart
long GoldEnd

if ( OnDeath )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to -1
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( GetPCSneaking )		; when PC is pickpocketing, ignore.
	elseif ( GetFatigue < 10 )	; when NPC is knocked out, ignore. <10 is for recovery animation.
	elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 0 )	; else initiate scrip exchange if PC has scrip
		if ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 > 0 )

			set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 1

			; add the topic so the merchant can be asked about it, in case player is confused
			AddTopic "Hlaalu Company scrip"

			set ScripStart to ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 )
			set GoldStart to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart

			while ( ScripCount > 0 )
				if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
					player->AddItem gold_001 10000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
					player->AddItem gold_001 1000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
					player->AddItem gold_001 100
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
					player->AddItem gold_001 10
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
					player->AddItem gold_001 1
				endif
			endwhile
			Return	; no activate now, delay one frame instead.
		endif
	endif
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 1 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 2
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 2 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 3	; skip one frame
elseif ( T_local_HHScripExchange == 3 )
	if ( MenuMode == 0 )

		set GoldEnd to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
		set GoldEnd to ( GoldEnd - ScripStart )
		set ScripCount to ( ScripStart - ( GoldStart - GoldEnd ) )

		if ( ScripCount > ScripStart )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart	; don't give the player more scrip than they had at the start, have profits be gold instead.
		endif

		while ( ScripCount > 0 )
			if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 100
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1
			endif
		endwhile
		set ScripCount to 0
		set ScripStart to 0
		set GoldStart to 0
		set GoldEnd to 0
		set T_local_HHScripExchange to 0

	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map4NineHoles
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting


; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set TR_Map to 4

; START DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; Depends on the early return due to T_Local_Khajiit! If used elsewhere, edit accordingly
set T_Glob_NineholesNpcId to ( T_Glob_NineholesNpcId + 1 )
set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId to T_Glob_NineholesNpcId
set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 1
if ( changelevel > 360 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
	if ( changelevel > 500 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 3
	elseif ( changelevel > 420 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
elseif ( changelevel > 120 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 2
	if ( changelevel > 150 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
endif
; END DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

End

begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map4VampBalAshwalker

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

;    PROVINCE LOCAL VARIABLES HERE
short nolore
short TR_Map
short T_Local_Vampire
short TR_BalAshwalker
short control
short controlQ

short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_NoLore

short checkBlood
short doOnce
short state

;Vanilla global PCVampire
;Vanilla global PCWerewolf
;Tamriel_Data global T_Glob_PorphyricInfected

;Baluath ash storm benefits variables
float timer
short ashStorm
short spawnDay
short disturbed

short fixHead
short T_Local_Khajiit

;------------------------------------------------
; Fade away in clear daylight if not disturbed
;------------------------------------------------

if ( GetDisabled )
	SetDelete 1
elseif ( GetWindSpeed == 0 )
elseif ( ashStorm )
elseif ( GameHour < 6 )
elseif ( GameHour >= 20 )
else
	if ( disturbed == 0 )
		set disturbed to 1
		set spawnDay to DaysPassed
	elseif ( disturbed == -1 )
		if ( GetPCSleep )
			Disable
			return
		else
			ModChameleon 1
			if ( GetChameleon >= 100 )
				Disable
				return
			endif
		endif
	endif
endif
if ( disturbed == 0 )
	set disturbed to -1
	set spawnDay to DaysPassed
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem "ingred_vampire_dust_01" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Quarra" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Aundae" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Berne" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif

	; prevent ashwalkers from staying around too long
	if ( DaysPassed > ( spawnDay + 1 ) )
		Disable
		return
	endif
endif

if ( fixHead )
	;Mod-added heads disappear when the Vampirism effect is removed/swapped
	;To fix this we equip a helmet and remove it to reset the head model
	set fixHead to 0
	equip T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer ;Lack of AddItem is intentional
	RemoveItem T_Glb_Var_HeadFixer 1
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;Baluath stuff, see cure script
set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
if ( timer > 1 )
	set timer to 0
	if ( ashStorm )
		set ashStorm to 0
	endif
	if ( GetWindSpeed )
		if ( GetCurrentWeather >= 6 ) ;ash
			if ( GetCurrentWeather <= 7 ) ;blight
				set ashStorm to 1
			endif
		endif
	endif
	if ( ashStorm )
		if ( GetSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_Ash" == 0 )
			AddSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_Ash"
			AddSpell "T_Vamp_Sp_Baluath_Ash"
			AddSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_SunDmg"
			RemoveSpell "vampire sun damage"
			set fixHead to 1
		endif
	elseif ( GetSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_Ash" )
		RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_Ash"
		RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Sp_Baluath_Ash"
		AddSpell "vampire sun damage"
		RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_SunDmg"
		set fixHead to 1
	endif
endif


;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects "T_Vamp_Dis_Baluath" )
		if ( ScriptRunning "T_ScVamp_Baluath_PC" != 1 )
			StartScript "T_ScVamp_Baluath_PC"
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 100 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	else
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

; Apply vampire spells/abilities to this NPC once

if ( doOnce == 0 )
	AddSpell "T_Vamp_Dis_Baluath"
	AddSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath"
	AddSpell "Vampire Attributes"
	AddSpell "Vampire Skills"
	AddSpell "Vampire Immunities"
	AddSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
	AddSpell "Vampire Touch"
	ModRestoration 75
	;set province-specific location variable for dialogue here
	set TR_Map to 4
	set TR_BalAshwalker to 1
	set doOnce to 1
	set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

	if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1

		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1

	endif
endif

; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is. This version is for Berne vampire NPCs.

short fightset
short cattlekilled
short nolore
short nohello
short noflee
short noidle
short nointruder
short nothief
short TR_Map
short T_Local_Vampire
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_NoLore
short T_Local_Khajiit

if ( GetJournalIndex "VA_VampCountess" == 70 )
	setFight 100
	setDisposition 0
	set cattlekilled to -1
endif

if ( OnDeath )
	if ( GetJournalIndex "VA_VampHunter" == 90 )
		if ( VampClan == 1 )
			set VampKills to ( VampKills + 1 )
		elseif ( VampClan == 2 )
			set VampKills to ( VampKills - 1 )
		elseif ( VampClan == 3 )
			set VampKills to ( VampKills + 1 )
		endif
	elseif ( GetJournalIndex "VA_VampAmulet" == 30 )
		if ( VampClan == 1 )
			set VampKills to ( VampKills + 1 )
		elseif ( VampClan == 2 )
			set VampKills to ( VampKills - 1 )
		elseif ( VampClan == 3 )
			set VampKills to ( VampKills + 1 )
		endif
	endif
	AddItem "ingred_vampire_dust_01" 1
endif

if ( done == -1 )
	return
endif

if ( done == 2 )
	;check for PC NO LONGER a Berne Vampire
	if ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Berne Specials" != 1 )
		setfight 90
		setdisposition 20
		set done to -1
	endif
	return
endif

if ( done == 1 )
	;check for PC as a Berne Vampire
	if ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Berne Specials" == 1 )
		setfight 30
		set done to 2
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Berne Specials" != 1 )
		if ( fightset == 0 )
			setfight 90
			setdisposition 20
			set fightset to 1
		endif
	endif
	return
endif

if ( done == 0 )
	AddSpell "Vampire Blood Berne"	;this is the blood disease
	AddSpell "Vampire Attributes"

	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )

	elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )

	endif

begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map4VampOrlukh

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

;    PROVINCE LOCAL VARIABLES HERE
short nolore
short TR_Map
short T_Local_Vampire
short control
short controlQ

short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_NoLore

short checkBlood
short doOnce
short state
short T_Local_Khajiit

;Vanilla global PCVampire
;Vanilla global PCWerewolf
;Tamriel_Data global T_Glob_PorphyricInfected

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem "ingred_vampire_dust_01" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Quarra" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Aundae" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Berne" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects "T_Vamp_Dis_Orlukh" )
		if ( ScriptRunning "T_ScVamp_Orlukh_PC" != 1 )
			StartScript "T_ScVamp_Orlukh_PC"
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 101 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	else
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Apply vampire spells/abilities to this NPC once
;------------------------------------------------

if ( doOnce == 0 )
	AddSpell "T_Vamp_Dis_Orlukh"
	AddSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Orlukh"
	AddSpell "Vampire Attributes"
	AddSpell "Vampire Skills"
	AddSpell "Vampire Immunities"
	AddSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
	AddSpell "Vampire Touch"
	ModRestoration 75
	;set province-specific location variable for dialogue here
	set TR_Map to 4
	set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

	if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	endif
	set doOnce to 1
endif

end

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map5HHScrip
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; This script also facilitates the treatment of Hlaalu Company Scrip as equivalent to gold,
; this is done by temporarily exchanging them for each other outside dialogue
; so no messages are displayed on the player's screen.

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
short T_Local_HHScripExchange
long ScripCount
long ScripStart
long GoldStart
long GoldEnd

if ( OnDeath )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to -1
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( GetPCSneaking )		; when PC is pickpocketing, ignore.
	elseif ( GetFatigue < 10 )	; when NPC is knocked out, ignore. <10 is for recovery animation.
	elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 0 )	; else initiate scrip exchange if PC has scrip
		if ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 > 0 )

			set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 1

			; add the topic so the merchant can be asked about it, in case player is confused
			AddTopic "Hlaalu Company scrip"

			set ScripStart to ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 )
			set GoldStart to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart

			while ( ScripCount > 0 )
				if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
					player->AddItem gold_001 10000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
					player->AddItem gold_001 1000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
					player->AddItem gold_001 100
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
					player->AddItem gold_001 10
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
					player->AddItem gold_001 1
				endif
			endwhile
			Return	; no activate now, delay one frame instead.
		endif
	endif
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 1 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 2
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 2 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 3	; skip one frame
elseif ( T_local_HHScripExchange == 3 )
	if ( MenuMode == 0 )

		set GoldEnd to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
		set GoldEnd to ( GoldEnd - ScripStart )
		set ScripCount to ( ScripStart - ( GoldStart - GoldEnd ) )

		if ( ScripCount > ScripStart )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart	; don't give the player more scrip than they had at the start, have profits be gold instead.
		endif

		while ( ScripCount > 0 )
			if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 100
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1
			endif
		endwhile
		set ScripCount to 0
		set ScripStart to 0
		set GoldStart to 0
		set GoldEnd to 0
		set T_local_HHScripExchange to 0

	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set TR_Map to 5

End

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map5NineHoles
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting


; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
endif
set TR_Map to 5

; START DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; Depends on the early return due to T_Local_Khajiit! If used elsewhere, edit accordingly
set T_Glob_NineholesNpcId to ( T_Glob_NineholesNpcId + 1 )
set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId to T_Glob_NineholesNpcId
set changelevel to T_Local_PlayNineholesGold
set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 1
set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 1
if ( changelevel > 360 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 3
	if ( changelevel > 500 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 3
	elseif ( changelevel > 420 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
elseif ( changelevel > 120 )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes to 2
	if ( changelevel > 150 )
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes to 2
	endif
endif
; END DoOnce variable settings code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

End

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map6HHScrip
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; This script also facilitates the treatment of Hlaalu Company Scrip as equivalent to gold,
; this is done by temporarily exchanging them for each other outside dialogue
; so no messages are displayed on the player's screen.

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
short T_Local_HHScripExchange
long ScripCount
long ScripStart
long GoldStart
long GoldEnd

if ( OnDeath )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to -1
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( GetPCSneaking )		; when PC is pickpocketing, ignore.
	elseif ( GetFatigue < 10 )	; when NPC is knocked out, ignore. <10 is for recovery animation.
	elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 0 )	; else initiate scrip exchange if PC has scrip
		if ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 > 0 )

			set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 1

			; add the topic so the merchant can be asked about it, in case player is confused
			AddTopic "Hlaalu Company scrip"

			set ScripStart to ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 )
			set GoldStart to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart

			while ( ScripCount > 0 )
				if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
					player->AddItem gold_001 10000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
					player->AddItem gold_001 1000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
					player->AddItem gold_001 100
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
					player->AddItem gold_001 10
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
					player->AddItem gold_001 1
				endif
			endwhile
			Return	; no activate now, delay one frame instead.
		endif
	endif
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 1 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 2
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 2 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 3	; skip one frame
elseif ( T_local_HHScripExchange == 3 )
	if ( MenuMode == 0 )

		set GoldEnd to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
		set GoldEnd to ( GoldEnd - ScripStart )
		set ScripCount to ( ScripStart - ( GoldStart - GoldEnd ) )

		if ( ScripCount > ScripStart )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart	; don't give the player more scrip than they had at the start, have profits be gold instead.
		endif

		while ( ScripCount > 0 )
			if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 100
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1
			endif
		endwhile
		set ScripCount to 0
		set ScripStart to 0
		set GoldStart to 0
		set GoldEnd to 0
		set T_local_HHScripExchange to 0

	endif
endif

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return
endif

set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map6NineHoles
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting


; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
elseif ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId != T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game doesn't belong to this NPC anymore
		set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 0
		Return
	endif
	if ( lastTurn != 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; New game started for this NPC
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC takes player's bet on game start
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					AddItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	elseif ( lastTurn == 20 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; Player won
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; NPC loses their bet + the player's part
				set wager to ( T_Glob_NineholesBet )
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 20
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					RemoveItem "Gold_001" 2
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
			endif
		endif
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState != lastTurn )
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Reset the game if NPC can't play it anymore
if ( OnDeath )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on death
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
if ( GetDisabled )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 1 )
		set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 ; Reset all game on disable
		set lastTurn to 0
	endif
endif
; END Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting

if ( T_Local_Khajiit )
	return

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map7HHScrip
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; This script also facilitates the treatment of Hlaalu Company Scrip as equivalent to gold,
; this is done by temporarily exchanging them for each other outside dialogue
; so no messages are displayed on the player's screen.

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
short T_Local_HHScripExchange
long ScripCount
long ScripStart
long GoldStart
long GoldEnd

if ( OnDeath )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to -1
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( GetPCSneaking )		; when PC is pickpocketing, ignore.
	elseif ( GetFatigue < 10 )	; when NPC is knocked out, ignore. <10 is for recovery animation.
	elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 0 )	; else initiate scrip exchange if PC has scrip
		if ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 > 0 )

			set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 1

			; add the topic so the merchant can be asked about it, in case player is confused
			AddTopic "Hlaalu Company scrip"

			set ScripStart to ( player->GetItemCount T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 )
			set GoldStart to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart

			while ( ScripCount > 0 )
				if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
					player->AddItem gold_001 10000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
					player->AddItem gold_001 1000
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
					player->AddItem gold_001 100
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
					player->AddItem gold_001 10
				elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
					set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
					player->RemoveItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
					player->AddItem gold_001 1
				endif
			endwhile
			Return	; no activate now, delay one frame instead.
		endif
	endif
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 1 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 2
	Activate
elseif ( T_Local_HHScripExchange == 2 )
	set T_Local_HHScripExchange to 3	; skip one frame
elseif ( T_local_HHScripExchange == 3 )
	if ( MenuMode == 0 )

		set GoldEnd to ( player->GetItemCount gold_001 )
		set GoldEnd to ( GoldEnd - ScripStart )
		set ScripCount to ( ScripStart - ( GoldStart - GoldEnd ) )

		if ( ScripCount > ScripStart )
			set ScripCount to ScripStart	; don't give the player more scrip than they had at the start, have profits be gold instead.
		endif

		while ( ScripCount > 0 )
			if ( ScripCount >= 10000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1000 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1000 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1000
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1000
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 100 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 100 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 100
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 100
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 10 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 10 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 10
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 10
			elseif ( ScripCount >= 1 )
				set ScripCount to ( ScripCount - 1 )
				player->AddItem T_De_HlaaluCompanyScrip_01 1
				player->RemoveItem gold_001 1
			endif
		endwhile
		set ScripCount to 0
		set ScripStart to 0
		set GoldStart to 0
		set GoldEnd to 0
		set T_local_HHScripExchange to 0

	endif
endif

	return
endif

	set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )

Begin T_ScNpc_Mw_Map7NineHoles
; This short script is there to allow dialogue to be filtered on the TR_Map local variable, 
; allowing for regional topics such as "Morrowind Lore" or "Geographic Regions" to be
; appropriate to the location the NPC is.
; It also adds the framework for playing the nine-holes minigame

short TR_Map
short control
short controlQ
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_Khajiit
short NoLore
; START Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState ; 0:not in game, 1:assigned to ongoing game
short T_Local_PlayNineholesGold ; Keeps track of the gold NPC has
short T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ; A (hopefully) unique ID of this NPC used to track if a game against them is played
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMinStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short T_Local_PlayNineholesMaxStakes ; 1(low), 2(mid), 3(high)
short lastTurn ; hold the previous value of T_Glob_NineholesGameState
short wager ; Used for money counting when adding/removing it.
short changelevel ; Initial gold value the NPC starts with, used for replenishing from time to time
short localDaysPassed ; DaysPassed storage, used for replenishing from time to time
; END Local variables for nine-holes NPC scripting


; START Main logic code snippet for the nine-holes NPC scripting
; -- Keep track of NPC's gold
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold != ( GetItemCount gold_001 ) )
	set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
endif

; -- Replenish gold after a week if it went below initial level
if ( changelevel > 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesGold < changelevel )
		if ( ( localDaysPassed + 7 ) <= DaysPassed ) ; At least a week passed
			set wager to ( changelevel - T_Local_PlayNineholesGold )
			while ( wager >= 10 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 10
				set wager to ( wager - 10 )
			endwhile
			while ( wager >= 1 )
				AddItem "Gold_001" 1
				set wager to ( wager - 1 )
			endwhile
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesGold to ( GetItemCount gold_001 )
			set localDaysPassed to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

; -- Track the game state and react to it
if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState == 0 )
	if ( T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId != 0 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcId ) ; The game now belongs to this NPC
			set T_Local_PlayNineholesNpcState to 1
			set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesGameState

		endif
	endif

begin T_ScObj_Armun_BaluathPile

; Handles enabling and digging up ashwalker ash piles in the Armun Ashlands.

short digOnce
short spawnDay
short shouldEnable
short messageOn
short button
float vampireChoice

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( digOnce == 0 )
		if ( player->GetItemCount "T_Com_Farm_Shovel_01" > 0 )
		elseif ( player->GetItemCount "misc_de_muck_shovel_01" > 0 )
		else
			MessageBox "You need a shovel to dig here."
			return
		endif
		MessageBox "Do you want to dig into the ash pile?" "Yes" "No"
		set messageOn to 1
	endif
endif

if ( messageOn == 1 )
	set button to GetButtonPressed
	if ( button == -1 )
		return

	elseif ( button == 0 )
		; choose a vampire to place
		set vampireChoice to ( Random 100 )
		if ( vampireChoice < 50 )
			MessageBox "You hit something."
			if ( vampireChoice < 10 )
				PlaceAtPC "TR_Vampire_Baluath_01" 1 100 0
			elseif ( vampireChoice < 20 )
				PlaceAtPC "TR_Vampire_Baluath_02" 1 100 0
			elseif ( vampireChoice < 30 )
				PlaceAtPC "TR_Vampire_Baluath_03" 1 100 0
			elseif ( vampireChoice < 40 )
				PlaceAtPC "TR_Vampire_Baluath_04" 1 100 0
			else
				PlaceAtPC "TR_Vampire_Baluath_05" 1 100 0
			endif
		elseif ( vampireChoice < 55 )
			MessageBox "You dig up rotting human flesh."
			MessageBox "Human Flesh has been added to your inventory."
			player->AddItem "ingred_human_meat_01" 1
		elseif ( vampireChoice < 60 )
			MessageBox "You dig up a skull."
			player->AddItem "misc_skull00" 10
			MessageBox "Skull has been added to your inventory."
		elseif ( vampireChoice < 69 )
			MessageBox "You dig up some gold."
			player->AddItem "Gold_001" 10
			MessageBox "10 Gold has been added to your inventory."
		elseif ( vampireChoice < 74 )
			MessageBox "You dig up a pouch of gold."
			player->AddItem "Gold_001" 25
			MessageBox "25 Gold has been added to your inventory."
		elseif ( vampireChoice < 75 )
			MessageBox "You dig up a large pouch of gold."
			player->AddItem "Gold_001" 100
			MessageBox "100 Gold has been added to your inventory."
		else
			MessageBox "You find nothing of interest."
		endif

		FadeOut 0.1
		FadeIn 1.0
		PlaySound "T_SndObj_Shovel01"
		set digOnce to 1
		set shouldEnable to 0
		set messageOn to 0

	elseif ( button == 1 )
		set messageOn to 0
	endif
endif

if ( CellChanged )
	; small chance to appear in daylight when there's no ash storm
	if ( GetCurrentWeather == 6 )
		set shouldEnable to 0
	elseif ( GameHour <= 4 ) ; one hour before damage sets in
		set shouldEnable to 0
	elseif ( GameHour >= 20 )
		set shouldEnable to 0
	elseif ( DaysPassed > ( spawnDay + 1 ) )
		; try to spawn at most once per day
		if ( Random 100 < 15 )
			set shouldEnable to 1
			set spawnDay to DaysPassed
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( shouldEnable == 1 )
	if ( GetDisabled )
		Enable
		set digOnce to 0
	endif
elseif ( GetDisabled == 0 )
	Disable
endif

end

begin T_ScObj_Armun_BaluathSpawner

; Spawns ashwalkers in the Armun Ashlands.

short spawnDay
float spawnChance
float vampireChoice

if ( CellChanged )
	; spawn at most once every other day
	if ( DaysPassed <= ( spawnDay + 1 ) )
		return
	endif
	set spawnDay to DaysPassed

	; calculate spawn chance based on combination of ash storm and night
	if ( GetCurrentWeather == 6 )
		; ash storm, early morning
		if ( GameHour <= 5 )
			set spawnChance to 75
		; ash storm, late night
		elseif ( GameHour >= 20 )
			set spawnChance to 75
		; ash storm, daytime
		else
			set spawnChance to 50
		endif
	; early morning, no ash storm (one hour before damage)
	elseif ( GameHour <= 4 )
		set spawnChance to 25
	; late night, no ash storm
	elseif ( GameHour >= 20 )
		set spawnChance to 25
	else
		return
	endif

	; no vampires here
	if ( Random 100 > spawnChance )
		return
	endif

	; choose a vampire to place
	set vampireChoice to ( Random 100 )
	if ( vampireChoice < 20 )
		PlaceAtMe "TR_Vampire_Baluath_01" 1 0 0
	elseif ( vampireChoice < 40 )
		PlaceAtMe "TR_Vampire_Baluath_02" 1 0 0
	elseif ( vampireChoice < 60 )
		PlaceAtMe "TR_Vampire_Baluath_03" 1 0 0
	elseif ( vampireChoice < 80 )
		PlaceAtMe "TR_Vampire_Baluath_04" 1 0 0
	else
		PlaceAtMe "TR_Vampire_Baluath_05" 1 0 0
	endif
endif

end

Begin T_ScObj_AylFallingFloor


float timer
float zPos
float zPosCeiling
float zPosFloor
short state

if ( MenuMode )
    Return
endif

if ( state == 0 )
    set zPosCeiling to ( GetPos Z )
    set zPosFloor to ( ( GetPos Z ) - 600  )
    set state to 1
elseif ( CellChanged )
    SetPos Z zPosCeiling
    set state to 1
    set timer to 0
endif

if ( state == 2 )
    set zPos to GetPos Z

    if ( zPos > zPosFloor)
        set zPos to ( zPos - 2 )
        SetPos Z zPos
        Return
    else
        set state to 3
		PlaySound3d "endboom1"
    endif
endif

if ( state == 3 )
    set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )

    if ( timer < 3 )
        Return
    endif

    set timer to 0
    set state to 4
    PlaySound3d "Door Stone Close"
endif

if ( state == 4 )
    set zPos to GetPos Z

    if ( zPos < zPosCeiling )
       set zPos to ( zPos + 0.5 )
        SetPos Z zPos
        Return
    else
        set state to 1
    endif
endif

if ( state == 1 )
    if ( GetDistance player < 300 )
        set state to 2
        PlaySound3d "Door Stone Close"
    endif
endif

End

;state 0 - one time setup
;state 1 - unique initial delay
;state 2 - main timer
;state 3 - falling
;state 4 - rising
 
if ( MenuMode )
    Return
endif
 
if ( CellChanged )
    if ( state > 0 )
        SetPos Z zPosCeiling
        set direction to 0
        set state to 1
        set timer to 0
    endif
endif

 if ( state == 0 )
    set zPosCeiling to ( GetPos Z )
    set zPosFloor to ( ( GetPos Z ) - 256 )
    set rando to ( ( Random 15 ) / 10 )
    set state to 1
endif

if ( state == 1 )
    set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
 
    if ( timer > rando )
        set state to 2
        set timer to 0
    endif
endif

if ( state == 2 )
    set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
 
    if ( timer < 4 )
        Return
    endif
 
    set timer to 0
 
    if ( direction == 0 )
        set state to 3
        PlaySound3d "Dwemer Door Close"
    else
        set state to 4
        PlaySound3d T_SndObj_ChainMechanism
    endif
endif
 
if ( state == 3 )
    set zPos to GetPos Z
 
    if ( zPos > zPosFloor )
        set zPos to ( zPos - 2 )
        SetPos Z zPos
        HurtCollidingActor 100
    else
        set direction to 1
        set state to 2
    endif
 
    Return
endif
 
if ( state == 4 )
    set zPos to GetPos Z
 
    if ( zPos < zPosCeiling )
        set zPos to ( zPos + 0.25 )
        SetPos Z zPos
    else
        set direction to 0
        set state to 2
    endif
 
    Return
endif
 
End

Begin T_ScObj_AylSecWall_Down
 ;Based on script by Rakanishu
 ;Modified by Phenoix12

float zPos
float zPosLowPoint
float zPosFloor
short state

;state 0 = Inital setup - store locations of floor and lowest point. Runs only once on first load.
;state 1 = wait for button input
;state 2 = determine direction to move
;state 3 = wall moves down
;state 4 = wall moves up

; THIS VERSION OF THE SCRIPT ASSUMES THE DOOR STARTS CLOSED AND SLIDES DOWN TO OPEN.
; SCRIPT IS SET UP FOR THE MODEL: PC_In_Ar_HallSecDoor01.nif. The small end hall style secret door

; The DOOR's ID must be unique. Unless you want a single button to control multiple doors.
; Doors of course must be in the same cell as their button.


if ( MenuMode )
	Return
endif

if ( state == 0 )
	set zPosFloor to ( GetPos Z )
	;The following is the height the door falls to.
	set zPosLowPoint to ( ( GetPos Z ) - 170 )
	set state to 1
elseif ( CellChanged )
	;Reset the door to closed upon leaving the cell. Comment out to let the door remain open though cell changes. Make sure reference persist is checked.
	;set state to 0
	;SetPos Z zPosFloor
endif

if ( state == 1 )
	;Door is waiting for command to open. Sctipt on the button will sent the call to change to the next state.
	Return
endif

if ( state == 2 )
	;Get the current Z height.
	set zPos to ( GetPos Z )

	;Value subtracted below must be set to half the height the door falls to.
	;This will allow to the script to check if the door is in its up or down position.
	if ( zpos > ( zPosFloor - 85) ) 
		set state to 3
		PlaySound3D "Door Stone Open"
	else
		set state to 4
		PlaySound3D "Door Stone Close"
	endif
endif 


if ( state == 3 )
	;Get the current Z height.
	set zPos to ( GetPos Z )

	if ( zPos > zPosLowPoint )
	;Move the door down until it reaches the set height.
		set zPos to ( zPos - 0.5 )
		SetPos Z zPos
		Return
	else
	;The door has reached the set height, return to state 1.
		set state to 1
		PlaySound3DVP "endboom1" 0.1 1.0
	endif
endif

if ( state == 4 )
	;Get the current Z height.
	set zPos to ( GetPos Z )

	if ( zPos < zPosFloor )
	;Move the door up until it reaches the set height.
		set zPos to ( zPos + 0.5 )
		SetPos Z zPos
		Return
	else
	;The door has reached the set height, return to state 1.
		set state to 1
		PlaySound3DVP "endboom1" 0.1 1.0
	endif
endif

End

Begin T_ScObj_AyleidDoorDouble

float timer
; a variable to prevent the door from frequently getting opened and closed by npcs
short state
; 0 = initial state
; 1 = opening
; 2 = open
; 3 = closing
; 4 = closed

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( onActivate == 1 )
	if ( getLocked > 0 )
		if (timer >= 1)
			set timer to 0
			playSound3D "LockedDoor"
		endif
	elseif ( state > 2 )
		if ( timer >= 1 )
			set state to 1
			set timer to 0
			playSound3D "Door Metal Open"
		endif
	elseif ( state < 3 )
		if ( getCollidingActor == 0 ) ; to prevent the closing while an npc collides with the door
			if ( timer >= 1 )
				set state to 3
				set timer to 0
				playSound3D "Door Metal Close"
			endif
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( timer < 1 )
	set timer to ( timer + getSecondsPassed )
endif

if ( state == 0 ); set the door to closed
	set state to 4
	set timer to 1
endif

if ( state == 1 ); the door is opening
	playGroup, idle2, 0
	set state to 2
	return
endif

if ( state == 2 ); the door has finished opening
	playGroup, idle4, 0
	return
endif

if ( state == 3 ); the door is closing
	playGroup, idle3, 0
	set state to 4
	return
endif

if ( state == 4 ); the door has finished closing
	playGroup, idle, 0
endif

	elseif ( col == 2 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len
		set rowLock to T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock
		set rowLock2 to T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock2
	elseif ( col == 3 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len
		set rowLock to T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock
		set rowLock2 to T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock2
	elseif ( col == 4 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len
		set rowLock to T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock
		set rowLock2 to T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock2
	elseif ( col == 5 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len
		set rowLock to T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock
		set rowLock2 to T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock2
	elseif ( col == 6 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len
		set rowLock to T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock
		set rowLock2 to T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock2
	endif
	if ( rowLock2 > rowLock )
		set rowLock to rowLock2
	endif
	if ( col > 0 )
		if ( rowLock >= row )
			; if we're not allowed to activate this one, don't activate.
			if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 8 )
				PlaySound "T_SndObj_TileDown"
				Set T_Glob_CardHortState to 7
			endif
			Return
		endif
	endif
	set active to 1
endif

if ( active == 1 )
	set active to 0
	if ( state == 1 )
		; if we're allowed to activate this one, then proceed
		if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 7 )

			PlaySound "T_SndObj_TileUp"
			; if no other card is selected, record who this is
			set T_Glob_CardHortState to 8		; holding-pattern state
			set T_Glob_CardHortHouse to house
			set T_Glob_CardHortRank to rank
			set T_Glob_CardHortCol to col
			set T_Glob_CardHortRow to row

		elseif ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 8 )	; else if another card has already been selected,
			if ( T_Glob_CardHortRank == ( rank + 1 ) )	; if that card preceded this one in rank
				if ( row == rowMax )							; if this one is the final one in the list
					if ( house != T_Glob_CardHortHouse )
						set T_Glob_CardHortCol to col				; then update row and column
						set T_Glob_CardHortRow to ( row + 1 )
					endif
				endif
			endif
			PlaySound "T_SndObj_TileDown"		; whether or not row and col were updated,
			set T_Glob_CardHortState to 7		; drop the cards.
		endif
	elseif ( state == 2 )	; if we're activating one of the lifted cards
		if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 8 )
			if ( col == T_Glob_CardHortCol )
				if ( row >= T_Glob_CardHortRow )
					if ( T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen > 1 )
						; safeguard, if somehow Dummy got set while length is wrong.
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy < 0 )
							Set T_Glob_CardHortDummy to 0
;							MessageBox "Dummy 0"
						endif
					endif
					if ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy < 0 )	; if there's a direct path to the final pile
						Set T_Glob_CardHortCol to ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy / 10 )
						Set T_Glob_CardHortRow to ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy - ( T_Glob_CardHortCol * 10 ) )
						Set T_Glob_CardHortDummy to 2
;						MessageBox "Dummy 2"
					elseif ( T_Glob_CardHortRank == 0 )	; if the originally lifted card was a Noble...
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len == 0 )
							if ( col != 6 )
								Set T_Glob_CardHortCol to 6
								Set T_Glob_CardHortRow to 1
							endif
						endif
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len == 0 )
							if ( col != 5 )
								Set T_Glob_CardHortCol to 5
								Set T_Glob_CardHortRow to 1
							endif
						endif
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len == 0 )
							if ( col != 4 )
								Set T_Glob_CardHortCol to 4
								Set T_Glob_CardHortRow to 1
							endif
						endif
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len == 0 )
							if ( col != 3 )
								Set T_Glob_CardHortCol to 3
								Set T_Glob_CardHortRow to 1
							endif
						endif
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len == 0 )
							if ( col != 2 )
								Set T_Glob_CardHortCol to 2
								Set T_Glob_CardHortRow to 1
							endif
						endif
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len == 0 )
							if ( col != 1 )
								Set T_Glob_CardHortCol to 1
								Set T_Glob_CardHortRow to 1
							endif
						endif
					elseif ( T_Glob_CardHortRank == 5 )	; if the originally lifted card was a Laborer...
						set T_Glob_CardHortCol to ( T_Glob_CardHortTop - 3 )
						set T_Glob_CardHortTop to ( T_Glob_CardHortTop - 1 )
						set T_Glob_CardHortRow to -1
					endif	; else just proceed to put them down
					PlaySound "T_SndObj_TileDown"
					set T_Glob_CardHortState to 7
				endif
			endif
		endif
	elseif ( state == 3 )
		if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 8 )
			PlaySound "T_SndObj_TileDown"
			set T_Glob_CardHortState to 7
			if ( T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen == 1 )
				if ( T_Glob_CardHortRank == ( rank - 1 ) )
					if ( T_Glob_CardHortHouse == house )
						set state to 4 ; make this card unactivatable
						set T_Glob_CardHortCol to col
						set T_Glob_CardHortRow to ( row - 1 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy < 0 )
							Set T_Glob_CardHortDummy to 0
						endif
					endif
				endif
			endif
		endif
	endif
	Return
endif

if ( state == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 8 )	; if a card was selected to be lifted
		if ( col == T_Glob_CardHortCol )	; if same column
			if ( row >= T_Glob_CardHortRow )	; if same or later row
				SetPos Z toZup		; lift
				set state to 2
				set rowNew to ( row - T_Glob_CardHortRow )		; record row difference
				if ( col == 1)				; adjust col length
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len - 1 )
				elseif ( col == 2 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len - 1 )
				elseif ( col == 3 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len - 1 )
				elseif ( col == 4 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len - 1 )
				elseif ( col == 5 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len - 1 )
				elseif ( col == 6 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len - 1 )
				endif
				set T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen to ( T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen + 1 )
			endif
		endif
	elseif ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 12 )
	; note, we've been cheating on our global variables... at this point:
	; T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen stores column
	; T_Glob_CardHortColXLen stores row
		if ( col == T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen )
			if ( col == 1 )
				set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len
			elseif ( col == 2 )
				set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len
			elseif ( col == 3 )
				set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len
			elseif ( col == 4 )
				set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len
			elseif ( col == 5 )
				set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len
			elseif ( col == 6 )
				set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len
			endif
			if ( row == ( rowMax - 1 ) )
				if ( T_Glob_CardHortRank != ( rank + 1 ) )
					if ( col == 1 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 2 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 3 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 4 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 5 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 6 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock2 to row
						endif
					endif
				elseif ( T_Glob_CardHortHouse == house )
					if ( col == 1 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 2 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 3 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 4 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 5 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock2 to row
						endif
					elseif ( col == 6 )
						if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock == 0 )
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock to row
						else
							set T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock2 to row
						endif
					endif
				endif
				if ( T_Glob_CardHortRow == -1 )
					Set T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen to 0
					Set T_Glob_CardHortState to 7
				else
					Set T_Glob_CardHortRow to ( T_Glob_CardHortRow + 1 )
					Set T_Glob_CardHortState to 10
				endif
			endif
		endif
	endif
elseif ( state == 2 )
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 7 )
		; lower
		SetPos Z toZ
		; set new col and row
		set colNew to T_Glob_CardHortCol
		set rowNew to ( T_Glob_CardHortRow + rowNew )

		; record state
		if ( colNew < 0 )
			set state to 3
		else
			set state to 1
		endif

		; update
		if ( colNew == 1)
			set T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len + 1 )
		elseif ( colNew == 2 )
			set T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len + 1 )
		elseif ( colNew == 3 )
			set T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len + 1 )
		elseif ( colNew == 4 )
			set T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len + 1 )
		elseif ( colNew == 5 )
			set T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len + 1 )
		elseif ( colNew == 6 )
			set T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len + 1 )
		endif
		set T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen to ( T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen - 1 )
	endif
elseif ( state == 3 )
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortHouse == house )
		if ( T_Glob_CardHortRank == ( rank - 1 ) )	; if it's the subsequent card
			if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 8 ) ; if a card was lifted
				if ( T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen == 1 )	; if it's just one
					if ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy == 0 )
						set T_Glob_CardHortDummy to ( 10 * col )				; coopt the dummy variable to communicate row and col
						set T_Glob_CardHortDummy to ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy + ( row - 1 ) )
;						MessageBox "Dummy %f.0" T_Glob_CardHortDummy
					endif
				elseif ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy != 0 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortDummy to 0
;					MessageBox "Dummy 0"
				endif
			elseif ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy > 1 )
				set T_Glob_CardHortDummy to 0
;				MessageBox "Dummy 0"
				set state to 4
			elseif ( T_Glob_CardHortDummy != 0 )
				set T_Glob_CardHortDummy to 0
;				MessageBox "Dummy 0"
			endif
		endif
	endif
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortTop <= -5 )	; all top rows have at least one card on them
		if ( rank == 0 )	; if this is a Noble
			set state to 4
			set T_Glob_CardHortTop to ( T_Glob_CardHortTop - 1 )
		endif
	endif
elseif ( state == -1 )
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 9 )
		if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol == col )
			if ( T_Glob_CardHortRow == row )
				set state to 1
				SetScale 1
				set T_Glob_CardHortState to 7
			endif
		endif
	endif
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 11 )
		if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol == col )
			if ( T_Glob_CardHortRow == row )
				set state to 1
				SetScale 1
				Set T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen to ( 7 + row )	; I'm cheating, re-using one global for another...
				set colNew to T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen
				if ( colNew == 1)
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len + 1 )
					set rowNew to T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len
				elseif ( colNew == 2 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len + 1 )
					set rowNew to T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len
				elseif ( colNew == 3 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len + 1 )
					set rowNew to T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len
				elseif ( colNew == 4 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len + 1 )
					set rowNew to T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len
				elseif ( colNew == 5 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len + 1 )
					set rowNew to T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len
				elseif ( colNew == 6 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len to ( T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len + 1 )
					set rowNew to T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len
				endif
				set T_Glob_CardHortRank to rank
				set T_Glob_CardHortHouse to house
				if ( rowNew > 1 )
					set T_Glob_CardHortState to 12
				else
					if ( T_Glob_CardHortRow == -1 )
						Set T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen to 0
						Set T_Glob_CardHortState to 7
					else
						Set T_Glob_CardHortRow to ( T_Glob_CardHortRow + 1 )
						Set T_Glob_CardHortState to 10
					endif
				endif
			endif
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( colNew != col )
	; if col has changed, move card

	set col to colNew
	set row to rowNew

	set toX to T_Glob_CardHortX
	set toY to T_Glob_CardHortY

	if ( col > 0 )
		set toX to ( toX + ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeX * 8 * ( col - 3.5 ) ) )
		set toY to ( toY + ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeY * 8 * ( col - 3.5 ) ) )
		set toX to ( toX - ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeY * 5.75 * ( 4 - row ) ) )
		set toY to ( toY + ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeX * 5.75 * ( 4 - row ) ) )
		if ( row > 1 )
			set toR to -10
			set toZ to ( T_Glob_CardHortZ + 1.26 )
			set toZup to ( toZ + 5 )
		elseif ( row <= 1 )
			set toR to 0
			set toZ to ( T_Glob_CardHortZ + 0.5 )
			set toZup to ( toZ + 5 )
		endif

	elseif ( col < 0 )
		set toX to ( toX + ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeX * -8 * ( col + 4 ) ) )
		set toY to ( toY + ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeY * -8 * ( col + 4 ) ) )
		set toX to ( toX - ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeY * 28.75 ) )
		set toY to ( toY + ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeX * 28.75 ) )
		set toZ to ( T_Glob_CardHortZ - 0.5 - row )
		set toR to 0
		set state to 3	; top of final pile
	endif

	SetPos X toX
	SetPos Y toY
	SetPos Z toZ
	SetAngle X toR

	if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock >= T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock to 0
	endif
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock >= T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock to 0
	endif
	if( T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock >= T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock to 0
	endif
	if( T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock >= T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock to 0
	endif
	if( T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock >= T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock to 0
	endif
	if( T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock >= T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock to 0
	endif
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock2 >= T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol1Lock2 to 0
	endif
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock2 >= T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol2Lock2 to 0
	endif
	if( T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock2 >= T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol3Lock2 to 0
	endif
	if( T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock2 >= T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol4Lock2 to 0
	endif
	if( T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock2 >= T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol5Lock2 to 0
	endif
	if( T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock2 >= T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len )
		Set T_Glob_CardHortCol6Lock2 to 0
	endif

endif

End

Begin T_ScObj_CardHortEmpty

short doOnce
float toX
float toY
float toZ
float toR
short house
short rank
short col
short row
short rowMax

if ( T_Glob_CardHortSaveLoad == 1 )
	SetPos X toX
	SetPos Y toY
	SetPos Z toZ
	SetAngle X toR
endif

if ( doOnce >= 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 0 )
		set doOnce to 3
		Disable
		SetDelete 1
	endif
	if ( doOnce == 2 )
		if ( T_Glob_CardHortSaveLoad == 1 )
			set T_Glob_CardHortSaveLoad to 0
		elseif ( GetScale > 0.2 )
			Set T_Glob_CardHortSaveLoad to 1
			SetScale 0.1
;			MessageBox "Detected save load"
		endif
	endif
elseif ( doOnce == 0 )


	if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 2 )
		; initial setup to retrieve X and Y offsets
		Disable
		set T_Glob_CardHortState to 3
		set T_Glob_CardHortReshapeX to GetPos X
		set T_Glob_CardHortReshapeY to GetPos Y
		SetScale 0.1
		set doOnce to 2

	else
		; placed in setup stage
		set house to T_Glob_CardHortHouse
		set rank to T_Glob_CardHortRank
		set col to T_Glob_CardHortCol
		set row to T_Glob_CardHortRow

		set toX to GetPos X
		set toY to GetPos Y
		set toX to ( toX + ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeX * T_Glob_CardHortX ) )
		set toY to ( toY + ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeY * T_Glob_CardHortX ) )
		set toX to ( toX - ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeY * T_Glob_CardHortY ) )
		set toY to ( toY + ( T_Glob_CardHortReshapeX * T_Glob_CardHortY ) )
		set toZ to T_Glob_CardHortZ
		set toR to T_Glob_CardHortRot
		SetPos X toX
		SetPos Y toY
		SetPos Z toZ
		SetAngle X toR

		set doOnce to 1

	endif
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	Return
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( col == 1 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len
	elseif ( col == 2 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol2Len
	elseif ( col == 3 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol3Len
	elseif ( col == 4 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol4Len
	elseif ( col == 5 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol5Len
	elseif ( col == 6 )
		set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol6Len
	endif
	if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 7 )
		if ( col < 0 )
			; if this is on one of the side stacks
			PlaySound "T_SndObj_TileUp"
			set T_Glob_CardHortState to 10	; distribute-stacks state
			set T_Glob_CardHortCol to col
			set T_Glob_CardHortRow to -6	; start at the top of the stack
			Return
		endif
		if ( row == rowMax )
			PlaySound "T_SndObj_TileUp"
			set T_Glob_CardHortState to 9		; uncover-card state
			set T_Glob_CardHortCol to col
			set T_Glob_CardHortRow to row
			Disable
			SetDelete 1
			Return
		endif
	elseif ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 8 )	; if another card was lifted
		PlaySound "T_SndObj_TileDown"
		set T_Glob_CardHortState to 7		; drop the selected cards
	endif
endif


if ( T_Glob_CardHortState == 12 )
; note, we've been cheating on our global variables... at this point:
; T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen stores column
; T_Glob_CardHortColXLen stores row
	if ( col == T_Glob_CardHortActiveLen )
		if ( col == 1 )
			set rowMax to T_Glob_CardHortCol1Len

		set daytime to -1; night
	elseif ( GameHour >= 19 )

	elseif ( GameHour >= 8 )
		set daytime to 1; day
	elseif ( GameHour >= 7 )
		set daytime to 2; morning
	else
		set daytime to -1; night
	endif

	if ( daytime == 2 )
		if ( daytimebefore != 2 )
			PlayGroup, Idle2, 1; dawn
		endif
	elseif ( daytime == -2 )
		if ( daytimebefore != -2 )
			PlayGroup, Idle3, 1; dusk
		endif
	elseif ( daytime == 1 )
		PlayGroup, Idle4, 1; day
	else
		PlayGroup, Idle5, 1; night
	endif

	set daytimebefore to daytime ; change the prior daytime to match the current one
endif


End T_ScObj_DaylightPanel
