Begin T_ScObj_DirenniDoor

float timer
; a variable to prevent the door from frequently getting opened and closed by npcs
short state
; 0 = initial state
; 1 = opening
; 2 = opened
; 3 = closing
; 4 = closed

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( onActivate == 1 )
	if ( getLocked > 0 )
		playSound3D "LockedDoor"
	elseif ( state >= 3 ); the door is closed
		if ( timer >= 5 )
			set state to 1
			set timer to 0
			playSound3D "Door Metal Open"
		endif
	else ; the door is open
		if ( getCollidingActor == 0 ) ; to prevent the closing while an npc collides with the door
			if ( timer >= 5 )
				set state to 3
				set timer to 0
				playSound3D "Door Metal Close"
			endif
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( timer < 5 )
	set timer to ( timer + getSecondsPassed )
endif

if ( state == 0 ); set the door to closed at the beginning
	set state to 4
	set timer to 5
endif

if ( state == 1 ); the door is opening
	playGroup, idle3, 0
	set state to 2
	return
endif

if ( state == 2 ); the door has finished opening
	playGroup, Idle6, 0
	return
endif

if ( state == 3 ); the door is closing
	playGroup, idle4, 0
	set state to 4
	return
endif

if ( state == 4 ); the door has finished closing
	if ( getLocked > 0 )
		playGroup, Idle5, 0
	else
		playGroup, Idle2, 0
	endif
endif

End T_ScObj_DirenniDoor

begin T_ScObj_Dreu_Door

float timer
short start
short loopTwice
short closeOnce

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
	;don't run time in Menu Mode. Very bad.
endif

if ( OnActivate == 1 )
	if ( start == 0 )
		set start to 1
		Loopgroup, idle2, 0, 1
		PlaySound3D, T_SndObj_DreughMembraneOpen
		set timer to 0
	endif
	return
	;when activated, we want to start movement on the next frame...
endif

if ( start == 0 )
	return
	;if we have't started, stop here for speed
endif

if ( loopTwice == 0 )
	Loopgroup, idle3, 1, 0
	set loopTwice to 1
endif

if ( timer > 11 )
	if ( closeOnce == 0 )
		Loopgroup, idle4, 0, 1
		PlaySound3D, T_SndObj_DreughMembraneClose
		set closeOnce to 1
	endif
	;after 20 seconds close the hidden door, but prevent player from reopening yet.
endif

if ( timer > 13 )
	set start to 0
	set timer to 0
	set closeOnce to 0
	set loopTwice to 0
	;after another 4 seconds enable the player to open the door again
endif

set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )

end

begin T_ScObj_Dwe_Button

short doonce
short push
float timer

if ( MenuMode )
	Return
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( push == 0 )
		if ( doonce == 1 )
			set push to 1
			PlaySound3D "steamATTACK1"
			MessageBox "Nothing happens when you push the button."
		elseif ( doonce == 0 )
			set push to 1
			set doonce to 1
			PlaySound3D SothaSpikes
			MessageBox "You hear something happen when you push the button."
			; DO SOMETHING HERE
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( push == 0 )
	Return
elseif ( push == 1 )
	set timer to 2.1
	LoopGroup Idle2 0 1
	set push to 2
endif

set timer to timer - GetSecondsPassed

if ( timer > 0 )
	Return
else
	set timer to 0
	set push to 0
	PlayGroup Idle
endif


end

Begin T_ScObj_Dwe_Coh_Charg

short state
float timer

; state 0 == empty
; state 1 == charging
; state 2 == lowering
; state 3 == done charging - ready to pick up

; idle == broken
; idle2 == charging
; idle3 == done charging

if ( CellChanged == 0 )
	if ( state == 0 )
		PlayGroup Idle
	elseif ( state == 2 )
		PlayGroup Idle3
	endif
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	Return
endif

if ( state == 1 )
	if ( timer > 0 )
		set timer to timer - GetSecondsPassed
	elseif ( timer <= 0 )
		set timer to 2.25
		PlaySound3DVP "Dwemer Door Close" 0.5 1.0
		set state to 2
		Return
	endif
elseif ( state == 2 )
	if ( timer > 0 )
		set timer to timer - GetSecondsPassed
	elseif ( timer <= 0 )
		set timer to 0
		set state to 3
		Return
	endif
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( state == 0 )
		if ( Player->GetItemCount "misc_dwrv_artifact50" >= 1 )
			Player->RemoveItem "misc_dwrv_artifact50" 1
			MessageBox "You place the Dwemer Coherer into the opening."
			PlaySound3DVP "Dwemer Door Close" 0.5 1.0
			LoopGroup Idle2 0 1
			set state to 1
			set timer to 8
			Return
		elseif ( Player->GetItemCount "T_Dwe_CohererPowered_01" >= 1 )
			MessageBox "Nothing happens when you place the Powered Dwemer Coherer into the socket."
			Return
		else
			MessageBox "You see an opening which might fit a Dwemer Coherer."
			Return
		endif
	elseif ( state == 3 )
		Player->AddItem "T_Dwe_CohererPowered_01" 1
		set state to 0
		Return

   if ( On == 1 )

            set Open to 0

      endif

   endif

endif

end

Begin T_ScObj_IndorilDoor

float timer
; a variable to prevent the door from frequently getting opened and closed by npcs
short state
; 0 = initial state
; 1 = opening
; 2 = opened
; 3 = closing
; 4 = closed

	return
endif

	if ( getLocked > 0 )
		playSound3D "LockedDoor"
	elseif ( state >= 3 ); the door is closed
		if ( timer >= 1 )
			set state to 1
			set timer to 0
			playSound3D "Door Metal Open"
		endif
	else ; the door is open
		if ( getCollidingActor == 0 ) ; to prevent the closing while an npc collides with the door
			if ( timer >= 1 )
				set state to 3
				set timer to 0
				playSound3D "Door Metal Close"
			endif
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( timer < 1 )
	set timer to ( timer + getSecondsPassed )
endif

if ( state == 0 ); set the door to closed at the beginning
	set state to 4
	set timer to 1
endif

if ( state == 1 ); the door is opening
	playGroup, idle3, 0
	set state to 2
	return
endif

if ( state == 2 ); the door has finished opening
	playGroup, Idle6, 0
	return
endif

if ( state == 3 ); the door is closing
	playGroup, idle4, 0
	set state to 4
	return
endif

if ( state == 4 ); the door has finished closing
		playGroup, Idle2, 0
endif

    set T_Glob_KingOrgCoffer_Gold to ( ( Random 1001 ) / 10 + 1 )
    set doOnce to 1

	if ( frameNum == 0 )
		ExplodeSpell "T_Com_Des_KingOrgCoffer_Vanish"
		set frameNum to 0.01
	endif

		set disappearing to 0

		PlaceAtPC T_Glb_UNI_OrgnumCoffer 1 128 1

	set frameNum to ( frameNum + 0.05 )

	set button to GetButtonPressed
	if ( button == 0 )
		;open it
		Set opening to 1
		Set messageOn to 0
	endif
	if ( button == 1 )
		; pick it up
		Activate
		Set messageOn to 0
		return
	endif
endif

	;25% chance of disappearing after 100 uses

		Playsound "Open Lock"

		if ( currDay > lastDay )
			set lastDay to currDay
			set T_Glob_KingOrgCoffer_Uses to ( T_Glob_KingOrgCoffer_Uses + 1 )
			set alreadyRolled to 0

begin T_ScObj_NineholesBoard

;-------------
; One of the scripts originally created for the "Nine-holes" mod
; by Dillon241. Ported to Tamriel Data and edited with author's permission.
;-------------

short messageOn
short button
short lastTurn
float timer
short wager
short control

if ( messageOn > 0 )
	set button to GetButtonPressed
	if ( button == -1 )
		return
	endif
	if ( messageOn == 1 ) ; Beginning the game
		if ( button < 2 ) ; Choosing Red/White
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin to 0
			PlaceAtMe T_Imp_PlayNineholesSpawner_01 1 7 0 ; Spawn game pieces in row 01 (top row)
			PlaceAtMe T_Imp_PlayNineholesSpawner_02 1 0 0 ; Spawn game pieces in row 02 (mid row)
			PlaceAtMe T_Imp_PlayNineholesSpawner_03 1 7 1 ; Spawn game pieces in row 03 (bottom row)
			if ( button == 0 )
				set T_Glob_NineholesPlayerColor to 1
				set T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn to 1
			elseif ( button == 1 )
				set T_Glob_NineholesPlayerColor to 2
				set T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn to 2
			endif
			if ( control == 101 )
				set T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode to 1
			else
				set T_Glob_NineholesGameState to 20
			endif
			set control to 1 ; board in usage
		else ; Don't play
			set control to 0 ; board not in usage
		endif
	elseif ( messageOn == 2 ) ; Betting
		if ( button == 0 ) ; Betting
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 ) ; pay bet
				set wager to T_Glob_NineholesBet
				while ( wager >= 10 )
					player->RemoveItem "Gold_001" 10
					set wager to ( wager - 10 )
				endwhile
				while ( wager >= 1 )
					player->RemoveItem "Gold_001" 1
					set wager to ( wager - 1 )
				endwhile
				PlaySound "Item Gold Down"
				MessageBox "%G Gold has been removed from your inventory." T_Glob_NineholesBet
			endif
			MessageBox "Choose a color to play nine-holes. [Challenge]" "Red" "White"
			set messageOn to 1
			return
		elseif ( button == 1 ) ; Practice
			MessageBox "Choose a color to play nine-holes. [Practice]" "Red" "White" "Don't play"
			set control to 101 ; practice mode chosen
			set messageOn to 1
			return
		else ; Don't play
			set control to 0 ; board not in usage
		endif
	elseif ( messageOn == 3 ) ; Resign
		if ( button == 0 ) ; yes
			set lastTurn to 0
			set control to 0 ; board not in usage
			set timer to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin to 0
			set T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn to 0 ; so that the pins disappear
			if ( T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode == 1 )
				set T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode to 0
			else
				set T_Glob_NineholesGameState to 42 ; player resigned a betting game
			endif
		endif
	endif
	set messageOn to 0
endif

if ( CellChanged )
	set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123
endif
; An outside script can set T_Glob_NineholesBet to -123 to clear the game at any time
if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet == -123 )
	set lastTurn to 0
	set control to 0 ; board not in usage
	set timer to 0
	; Every game board instance in the cell shall run this cleanup, but maybe it's okay
	set T_Glob_NineholesBet to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02a to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03a to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01b to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02b to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03b to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01c to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_02c to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_03c to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn to 0 ; so that the pins disappear
	set T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId to 0
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 )
		MessageBox "You canceled your last game of nine-holes." "Ok"
	elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode == 1 )
		MessageBox "You canceled your last practice game of nine-holes." "Ok"
	endif
	set T_Glob_NineholesGameState to 0
	set T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode to 0
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

if ( T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn == 0 ) ; clearing the timer in case the game is canceled
	if ( timer > 0 )
		set timer to 0
	endif
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn > 0 ) ; pending game
	if ( lastTurn != T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn )
		set lastTurn to T_Glob_NineholesPlayerTurn
		if ( lastTurn != T_Glob_NineholesPlayerColor )
			set timer to 3
		endif
	endif
	if ( timer > 0 )
		set timer to ( timer - GetSecondsPassed )
		if ( timer <= 1 )
			StartScript "T_ScGlobal_NineholesAiMove"
			set timer to 0
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( OnActivate )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode == 1 ) ; practice mode ongoing
		if ( control != 0 )
			set control to 2 ; player may resign
		else
			set control to 20 ; player may not resign
		endif
	elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 20 ) ; game ongoing
		if ( control != 0 )
			set control to 2 ; player may resign
		else
			set control to 20 ; player may not resign
		endif
	elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 0 ) ; no game ongoing
		set control to 10 ; player could play the betting game
	elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState == 30 ) ; player last won a betting game
		; With a won betting game you have to go back to the NPC
		set control to 3 ; player may play practice
	elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesGameState >= 40 ) ; player last lost or resigned a betting game
		set control to 10 ; player could play the betting game
	endif

	if ( control == 10 ) ; Check if player can play the betting game
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesOpponentId == 0 ) ; no opponent
			set control to 3 ; player may play practice
		elseif ( player->GetItemCount "Gold_001" < T_Glob_NineholesBet ) ; not enough gold for bet
			set control to 4 ; player may play practice due to lack of gold
		else
			set control to 5 ; player may play a betting game
		endif
	endif

	if ( control == 2 )
		MessageBox "Resign the game?" "Yes" "No"
		set messageOn to 3
	elseif ( control == 3 )
		MessageBox "Choose a color to play nine-holes. [Practice]" "Red" "White" "Don't play"
		set control to 101 ; practice mode chosen
		set messageOn to 1
	elseif ( control == 4 )
		MessageBox "Choose a color to play nine-holes. [Practice, as you cannot afford the %G gold bet]" T_Glob_NineholesBet "Red" "White" "Don't play"
		set control to 101 ; practice mode chosen
		set messageOn to 1
	elseif ( control == 5 )
		if ( T_Glob_NineholesBet > 0 )
			MessageBox "Accept opponent's challenge? [Bet %G gold]" T_Glob_NineholesBet "Bet" "Practice" "Don't play"
		else
			MessageBox "Accept opponent's challenge? [No starting gold bet]" "Accept" "Practice" "Don't play"
		endif
		set control to 100 ; non-practice mode chosen
		set messageOn to 2
	elseif ( control == 20 )
		MessageBox "You're already playing a game on a different board."
		set control to 0 ; board not in usage
	endif
endif

end

begin T_ScObj_NineholesPinR_01a

;-------------

float zpos ; Also a normal Z position of the pin
float zposmax ; Z position of the pin when selected

float oZ ; Randomized Z rotation of the pin when it's in place
float oX ; Randomized X rotation of the pin when it's in place
float oY ; Randomized Y rotation of the pin when it's in place
short enabled ; Controls the picking up/placing down repositioning so that only the human player influences it

if ( doOnce == 0 )
	set targz to ( ( GetPos Z ) + 14.265 )
	SetPos Z targz

	set oX to ( ( GetAngle X ) + 12.8 )
	set oY to ( ( GetAngle Y ) + 12.7 )
	set oZ to ( ( GetAngle Z ) + 325.5 )

	SetAngle X oX
	SetAngle Y oY
	SetAngle Z oZ

	set zpos to ( GetPos Z )
	set zposmax to ( zpos + 10 )
	set doOnce to 1

	if ( T_Glob_NineholesPracticeMode != 1 ) ; no practice game ongoing
		SetDelete 1

		Enable
	endif
elseif ( T_Glob_NineholesPosTakenBy_01a != 1 )
	Disable

				SetAngle Y 0.0
				SetAngle Z 0.0
			endif
		endif
	endif
elseif ( enabled < 2 )
	if ( T_Glob_NineholesSelectedPin != 1 )
		SetPos Z zpos
		SetAngle X oX
		SetAngle Y oY
		SetAngle Z oZ
		set enabled to 2
	endif

	if ( MenuMode ) ; Close the inventory if opened (and continue)
		MenuTest 0
	endif

begin T_ScObj_OrcAltarWarrior

;script for the Orcish sacrifical stone
;grants a dubious blessing when given a blood offering

short button
short questionState

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( OnActivate == 1 )
	set questionState to 1
	MessageBox, "Will you offer your own blood to the Warrior Spirit?" "Offer your own blood." "Nevermind."
	return
endif

if ( questionState == 0 )
	return
endif

if ( questionState == 1 )
	set button to GetButtonPressed
		if ( button == -1 )
			return
		elseif ( button == 0 )
			set questionState to 2
		elseif ( button == 1 )
			set questionState to 0
		endif
endif
	
if ( questionState == 2 )

	Cast "spirit knife" player
	PlaySound "Item Weapon Shortblade Up"
	PlaySoundVP "hrkr moan" 1.0 0.5

	if ( PCVampire == 1 )	;Vampire
		MessageBox, "Your undead blood is refused, vampire."
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )		;if the player is a werewolf
		MessageBox, "Your blood spills upon the stone. The spirits recognize a Hound of Hircine! You receive the Spirit of the Warrior."
		Cast "T_Orc_Res_SpiritWarrior" player
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == -1 )		;if the player has been a werewolf
		MessageBox, "Your blood spills upon the stone. The spirits recognize that you were once a Hound of Hircine! You receive the Spirit of the Warrior."
		Cast "T_Orc_Res_SpiritWarrior" player
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( player->GetBlightDisease == 1 )		;diseased
		MessageBox, "Your blighted blood is refused."
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( player->GetCommonDisease == 1 )		;diseased
		MessageBox, "Your diseased blood is refused."
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( player->GetLevel < 10 )		;too weak
		MessageBox, "Your weakling blood is refused."
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( PCRace == 2 )		;Breton
		MessageBox, "Your blood is that of the Old Adversary, Breton. Your offering is refused."
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( PCRace == 3 )		;Dark Elf
		MessageBox, "Your blood is that of the Betrayer, Dunmer. Your offering is refused."
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( PCRace == 5 )		;Imperial
		MessageBox, "Your blood is that of the Old Adversary, Imperial. Your offering is refused."
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( PCRace == 7 )		;Nord
		MessageBox, "Your blood is that of the Old Adversary, Nord. Your offering is refused."
		set questionState to 0
	elseif ( PCRace == 9 )		;Redguard
		MessageBox, "Your blood is that of the Old Adversary, Redguard. Your offering is refused."
		set questionState to 0
	else
		MessageBox, "Your blood spills upon the stone. In return, you receive the Spirit of the Warrior."
		Cast "T_Orc_Res_SpiritWarrior" player
		set questionState to 0
	endif

endif


end

            ExplodeSpell "T_Mw_Des_PoisonBloom"

    set timer to 0
    set spellInterval to 0
endif

short OpenMenu
short button
short doOnce
short PCSkipEquip
short ChooseAnimation
short control
short splashSound
short plesiosaurDisposition
short firsttime
short pearl
short giftCheck
short ran

	set PCSkipEquip to 1
endif

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
	return
endif

if ( OnActivate == 1 )
	if ( OpenMenu == 0 )
		if ( firsttime == 0 )
			MessageBox "It is a newly hatched seadrake! It snaps and hisses at you, seemingly taking you for a predator. If you give it fish feed, you might be able to win the tiny creature over." "Interact with it." "Pick up the bowl." "Leave it alone."
			PlaySound, "T_SndCrea_TinyPlesiosaurHiss"

			set OpenMenu to 1
		elseif ( firsttime == 1 )
			MessageBox, "It is a tiny seadrake in a bowl." "Interact with it." "Pick up the bowl." "Leave it alone."
			set OpenMenu to 1
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( OpenMenu == 1 )
	set button to GetButtonPressed
		if ( button == -1 )
			;no button pressed
			return
			set OpenMenu to 0
		elseif ( button == 0 )
			;"Interact with it" pressed
			if ( player->GetItemCount, "T_Com_FishFeed_01" == 0 )

					MessageBox, "The tiny seadrake watches you with curiosity."
					PlaySound, "T_SndCrea_TinyPlesiosaurIdle"

begin T_ScObj_RHCClockMinHand

float hourAdjusted
long hourTruncated
float minAdjusted
long minTruncated
float angleForCurrentHour
float modHour
float modHourX
float modHourXX

if ( gamehour > 12 )
    set hourAdjusted to ( gamehour - 12)
else
    set hourAdjusted to ( gamehour )
endif

set hourTruncated to hourAdjusted
set minAdjusted to (60*hourAdjusted - 60*hourTruncated)
set minTruncated to minAdjusted
set modHour to (minAdjusted - minTruncated)
set modHourX to ( modHour * modHour * modHour * modHour * modHour * modHour * modHour)
set modHourXX to ( modHourX * modHourX * modHourX * modHourX * modHourX * modHourX * modHourX)
set angleForCurrentHour to ( minTruncated * 6 + modHourXX * modHourXX * modHourXX * modHourXX * 6)

SetAngle, x, angleForCurrentHour

end

  return

begin T_ScObj_StockExchangeAMC

; While the player is present in the cell containing this script's item, the relevant company's stocks can be traded
; and its stock price calculations are done daily (also accounting for the time player spent away from the cell
; or for the case when the stock price was already modified on that day by a different instance of this item elsewhere).
; The item should be placed in every interior cell where there's a broker supposed to trade in this company's stocks
; or where's the questgiver who modifies the company base value variable.

short doOnce
short change
short dayCheck
short timerday
long goldHold ; boundary value, used in limiting the stock value to be too big or too small

if ( T_Glob_StockStarted < 1 ) ; Don't run anything when the player is not registered at the stock exchange
	return
endif

if ( doOnce == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_StockStarted > 1 ) ; Companies are still being reset, wait until they're done
		return
	endif

	; Resetting done, now set this company as enabled
	if ( T_Glob_StockEnableAMC < 0 )
		set T_Glob_StockEnableAMC to ( T_Glob_StockEnableAMC * -1 )
	endif

	set doOnce to 0
	return
endif

if ( CellChanged )
	; Execute reset of all companies on cell entry (if not executed already by a different company item) and wait until it's done
	set doOnce to 1
	if ( T_Glob_StockStarted == 1 )
		set T_Glob_StockStarted to 2
		if ( ScriptRunning T_ScStocks_DisableCompanies == 0 )
			StartScript T_ScStocks_DisableCompanies
		endif
	endif
	return
endif

; Actual stock calculations

set dayCheck to T_Glob_StockEnableAMC
if ( dayCheck < 0 )
	set dayCheck to ( dayCheck * -1 )
endif

if ( dayCheck >= DaysPassed )
	return
endif

if ( dayCheck == 0 )
	set dayCheck to ( DaysPassed - 1 )
endif

set timerday to ( DaysPassed - dayCheck )
while ( timerday > 0 ) ; should run a calculation for every day passed since the last time it was executed
	set change to ( random 101 )
	if ( change > 37 ) ; 37% chance of no change today
		Set goldHold to T_Glob_StockBaseAMC
		Set change to ( ( random 25 ) - 12 )
		Set change to ( change * goldHold / 30 )
		if change > 0
			if T_Glob_StockPriceAMC > ( goldHold * 2.95 )
				set change to -change
			endif
		elseif T_Glob_StockPriceAMC < ( goldHold * 0.7 )
			set change to -change
		endif
		set T_Glob_StockPriceAMC to ( T_Glob_StockPriceAMC + change )
	endif

	set timerday to ( timerday - 1 )
endwhile

set T_Glob_StockEnableAMC to DaysPassed

end

; The item should be placed in every interior cell where there's a broker supposed to trade in this company's stocks
; or where's the questgiver who modifies the company base value variable.

short doOnce
short change
short dayCheck
short timerday
long goldHold ; boundary value, used in limiting the stock value to be too big or too small

if ( T_Glob_StockStarted < 1 ) ; Don't run anything when the player is not registered at the stock exchange
	return
endif

if ( doOnce == 1 )
	if ( T_Glob_StockStarted > 1 ) ; Companies are still being reset, wait until they're done
		return
	endif

	; Resetting done, now set this company as enabled
	if ( T_Glob_StockEnableWPG < 0 )
		set T_Glob_StockEnableWPG to ( T_Glob_StockEnableWPG * -1 )
	endif

	set doOnce to 0
	return

begin T_ScObj_TikiTorchUnlit128
;Tamriel Rebuilt Activator Script
;
;This script should be attached to an x\furn_tikitorch_out.nif model.
;When the player activates the torch, the unlit torch is disabled, scaled to 0.1,
;and a lit tiki torch, "T_Com_Var_TikiDoNotUse01_128" appears at the same location.
;The unlit torch is persitant, but the lit torch is not.
;
;If the player loads a save game, and is in the cell with a torch that should be lit,
;the script uses the fact that upon loading, all objects that have scales set to <0.5 will
;be rescaled to a value of 0.5. If this condition is found, then a lit tiki is placed in-game.
;
;Upon a cellchange condition, the lit tiki torches will disappear, and the unlit torch is returned
;to its initial condition; enabled and scale=1.0. Therefore, the player must relit
;the torches whenever he/she changes cells.
;
;This script does not work with rotated torches, so the X,Y and Z rotation of the
;activator must all be 0. Nor does it work with scaled torches.

short lit_tiki  ; State of tiki torch  0=unlit state, 1=lit state

if ( GetScale == 0.5 )
   ;reactive light (player came in via load game)
   PlaceAtMe "T_Com_Var_TikiDoNotUse01_128" 1 0 1
   SetScale 0.1
   set lit_tiki to 1
   Return
endif

if ( MenuMode == 1 )
   Return
endif

if ( CellChanged )
   ;Player reentered cell - lit tikis will be deleted
   ;rescale object and activate it
   ;player will need to relight tiki
   if ( lit_tiki == 1 )
      SetScale 1.0
      Set lit_tiki to 0
      enable
   endif
   Return
endif

if ( OnActivate == 1 )
   ;when player activates object (unlit tiki)
   ;replace with lit tiki, disable and scale object
   if ( lit_tiki == 0 )
      PlaceAtMe "T_Com_Var_TikiDoNotUse01_128" 1 0 1
      disable
      SetScale 0.1
      set lit_tiki to 1
   endif
endif

End T_ScObj_TikiTorchUnlit128

begin T_ScObj_WaterSimulation 

;This script makes the sound of walking in water provided the PC is standing 
; on an object that this script is attached to. 
; Uses no outside variables. 
; Should be attached to terrain_bc_scum* (as an activator) and an editor marker box. 
; Cannot be attached to T_Glb_TerrWater_01_* because they do not have any form of collision detection, 
; and thus cannot detect if the PC is standing on it. Editor Marker Boxes must be placed 
; at ground level beneath the water instead. 

short InAir ;for jumping 

;for jumping outside of water 
if ( GetPCJumping == 1 ) 
    set InAir to 1 
endif 

if ( GetStandingPC == 1 ) 

    ;landing in water
    if ( InAir == 1 )
        if ( player->GetSoundPlaying "DefaultLand" == 1 )
            player->StopSound "DefaultLand"
            player->PlaySound3D "DefaultLandWater"
            set InAir to 0
        endif
    endif

    ;left foot 

    if ( player->GetSoundPlaying "FootBareLeft" == 1 )
        player->StopSound "FootBareLeft"
        player->PlaySound3D "FootWaterLeft"
    endif
    if ( GetSoundPlaying "FootHeavyLeft" == 1 )
        player->StopSound "FootHeavyLeft"
        player->PlaySound3D "FootWaterLeft"
    endif
    if ( GetSoundPlaying "FootMedLeft" == 1 )
        player->StopSound "FootMedLeft"
        player->PlaySound3D "FootWaterLeft"
    endif
    if ( GetSoundPlaying "FootLightLeft" == 1 )
        player->StopSound, "FootLightLeft"
        player->PlaySound3D "FootWaterLeft"
    endif

    ;right foot 

    if ( player->GetSoundPlaying "FootBareRight" == 1 ) 
        player->StopSound "FootBareRight"
        player->PlaySound3D "FootWaterRight"
    endif 
    if ( GetSoundPlaying "FootHeavyRight" == 1 ) 
        player->StopSound "FootHeavyRight"

    set timer2 to 3
    PlaySound3DVP T_SndEnv_Birds_01_07 1.0 1.0

Begin T_ScSound_VelothiGourdHarp

short RightWeather
short CheckWeather
short Pitch
float timer

;---this bit checks if the harp has been placed indoors... weird but it could happen

if ( GetInterior == 1 )		
	if ( GetSoundPlaying "T_SndObj_VelothGourd" == 0 )				;if the harp is indoors it will not sing
		PlayLoopSound3DVP "T_SndObj_VelothGourd", 0.20, 0.20		;but there will be a low, quiet humming instead
	endif
endif

if ( CellChanged == 1 )
	set CheckWeather to 0
endif

;--the harp can only sing in certain weather conditions: no rain

if ( CheckWeather == 0 )				
	if ( GetCurrentWeather == 0 )	;the weather is Clear
		set RightWeather to 1
		set CheckWeather to 1
		;MessageBox "Weather ok."
	elseif ( GetCurrentWeather == 1 )	;the weather is Cloudy
		set RightWeather to 1
		set CheckWeather to 1
		;MessageBox "Weather ok."
	elseif ( GetCurrentWeather == 2 )	;the weather is Foggy
		set RightWeather to 1
		set CheckWeather to 1
		;MessageBox "Weather ok."
	elseif ( GetCurrentWeather == 3 )	;the weather is Overcast
		set RightWeather to 1
		set CheckWeather to 1
		;MessageBox "Weather ok."
	elseif ( GetCurrentWeather == 6 )	;the weather is Ash Stormy
		set RightWeather to 1
		set CheckWeather to 1
		;MessageBox "Weather ok."
	else
		set RightWeather to 2
		set CheckWeather to 1
		StopSound, "T_SndObj_VelothGourd"
		;MessageBox "Weather BAAAAAAD."
		;MessageBox, "Sound stopped."
	endif
endif

;--the scale affects the pitch, the larger the instrument the lower the pitch

if ( Pitch == 0 )
	if ( GetScale >= 1.60 )
		set Pitch to 1
	elseif ( GetScale >= 1.40 )
		set Pitch to 2
	elseif ( GetScale >= 1.20 )
		set Pitch to 3
	elseif ( GetScale >= 1.00 )
		set Pitch to 4
	elseif ( GetScale >= 0.80 )
		set Pitch to 5
	elseif ( GetScale >= 0.50 )
		set Pitch to 6
	endif
endif

;---after the correct weather and the pitch have been checked the harp can sing

if ( CellChanged == 0 )
	if ( RightWeather == 1 )
		if ( GetSoundPlaying "T_SndObj_VelothGourd" == 0 )
			if ( Pitch == 1 )
				PlayLoopSound3DVP "T_SndObj_VelothGourd", 1.00, 0.40
			elseif ( Pitch == 2 )
				PlayLoopSound3DVP "T_SndObj_VelothGourd", 1.00, 0.50
			elseif ( Pitch == 3 )
				PlayLoopSound3DVP "T_SndObj_VelothGourd", 1.00, 0.60
			elseif ( Pitch == 4 )
				PlayLoopSound3DVP "T_SndObj_VelothGourd", 1.00, 0.80
			elseif ( Pitch == 5 )
				PlayLoopSound3DVP "T_SndObj_VelothGourd", 1.00, 0.90
			elseif ( Pitch == 6 )

Begin T_ScSpeech_SkillCheck

; Tamriel Data Standardized Speech Skill Check Script by Why
;
; Script for generating three globals based on the difference of persuasion power between NPC and PC.
; Derives persuasion power based on NPC and PC attributes and skills, disposition, and PC fatigue.
; There are three options, that each take different attributes into account for persuasion power:
;	Sway		---->	Speechcraft 		+  ( Personality / 2 ) 	+  ( Luck / 10 )
;	Haggle	---->	Mercantile 			+  ( Personality / 2 ) 	+  ( Luck / 10 )
;	Debate	---->	( Speechcraft / 2 ) 	+  Intelligence 			+  ( Luck / 10 )
; This is further multiplied ( for NPCs ) by disposition ( ranging from 1.5 for 0, to 0.5 for 100, linear scaling ) and
;   ( for the PC ) by fatigue ( ranging from 0.5 for 0, to 1 at max, with a SQRT curve to be more forgiving closer to max )
; These final power values are then compared by dividing the PC's persuasion power by the NPC's persuasion power
;   and the results are sent to the globals T_Glob_Speech_Sway, T_Glob_Speech_Haggle and T_Glob_Speech_Debate.
;
; The benefit of this approach is that many different attributes and skills can matter when we want to implement speech skill checks.
; No longer do speech skill checks need to be implemented on a case-by-case basis, and NPC stats actually matter!
;
; The downside of this script is that it can be a little unclear what an NPC's persuasive power will be from the Construction Set.
; To alleviate this, I included the global T_Glob_Speech_Debug that can help you explore how the NPC and PC power values are constructed in-game.
; The global is set to 0 by default. Set it to higher values to gain dynamic feedback on how the script calculates its values.
;
; 	T_Glob_Speech_Debug = 0		---->	No debug messages
; 	T_Glob_Speech_Debug = 1		---->	List final power values
; 	T_Glob_Speech_Debug = 2		---->	also list all relevant attributes
; 	T_Glob_Speech_Debug = 3		---->	also enable dummy Greeting 0 entry for all NPCs
;
; The script should be iniated from dialogue, so that it runs on the relevant NPC, along with a choice menu.
; Choice results should check the value of the relevant global ( see the Greeting 0 entries for an example ).
; Values of the globals indicate the relative strength of PC vs NPC - check for >= 1 for approximately equal stats.
; If wanted, you can increase or decrease this value to make harder or easier checks, or you can implement 
;   different results tied to the same choice, based on how large the power difference is.
;
; Globals do not need to be reset afterwards - calling the script again simply updates them, and they are only relevant for the subsequent choice results.

		; relevant npc variables
float npcSpeechcraft
float npcMercantile
float npcPersonality
float npcIntelligence
float npcLuck
float npcDisposition
float npcPower

		; relevant player variables
float pcSpeechcraft
float pcMercantile
float pcPersonality
float pcIntelligence
float pcLuck
float pcFatigueCurrent
float pcFatigueMax
float pcFatigueRatio
float pcPower

		; output globals
;global T_Glob_Speech_Sway
;global T_Glob_Speech_Haggle
;global T_Glob_Speech_Debate

		; debug global
;global T_Glob_Speech_Debug

		; retrieve stats
	; NPC stats don't need a fix, is targeted script
set npcDisposition 	to GetDisposition
set npcSpeechcraft	to GetSpeechcraft
set npcMercantile 		to GetMercantile
set npcPersonality 	to GetPersonality
set npcIntelligence 	to GetIntelligence
set npcLuck 			to GetLuck

	; player fatigue
set pcFatigueCurrent	to ( player->GetFatigue )
;raise fatigue to get the max
player->ModCurrentFatigue 10000
set pcFatigueMax		to ( player->GetFatigue )
;reset fatigue to original value, cheekily using the output variable to store the difference, so that I don't have to introduce a new one
set pcFatigueRatio 	to ( pcFatigueCurrent - pcFatigueMax )
player->ModCurrentFatigue pcFatigueRatio
;now compute the actual fatigue ratio
set pcFatigueRatio 	to ( pcFatigueCurrent / pcFatigueMax )

	; player skills and attributes
set pcSpeechcraft 		to ( player->GetSpeechcraft )
set pcMercantile 		to ( player->GetMercantile )
set pcPersonality 		to ( player->GetPersonality )
set pcIntelligence 		to ( player->GetIntelligence )
set pcLuck 				to ( player->GetLuck )

	; debug
if ( T_Glob_Speech_Debug >= 2 )
	MessageBox "npcSpeechcraft %.0f 		npcMercantile %.0f 	npcPersonality %.0f 		npcIntelligence %.0f 	npcLuck %.0f" 		npcSpeechcraft 	npcMercantile 		npcPersonality 	npcIntelligence 	npcLuck
	MessageBox "pcSpeechcraft %.0f 		pcMercantile %.0f 		pcPersonality %.0f 		pcIntelligence %.0f 	pcLuck %.0f" 		pcSpeechcraft 		pcMercantile 		pcPersonality 		pcIntelligence 		pcLuck
	MessageBox "npcDisposition %.0f" 		npcDisposition
	MessageBox "pcFatigueCurrent %.0f 	pcFatigueMax %.0f 	pcFatigueRatio %.3f" 		pcFatigueCurrent 	pcFatigueMax 		pcFatigueRatio
endif

	; make disposition matter
; multipliers behave a bit weird, this makes it more consistent
; 0 means your skills need to be 1.5 times as high, 
; 100 means your skills can be 1.5 times as low.
set npcDisposition to ( 1.5 - ( npcDisposition / 100 ) )
if ( npcDisposition < 1 )
	set npcDisposition to ( 1 / ( 2 - npcDisposition ) )
endif

	; adjust fatigue, less harsh of a falloff and implement a floor
set pcFatigueRatio to ( GetSquareRoot pcFatigueRatio )
set pcFatigueRatio to ( 0.5 + ( 0.5 * pcFatigueRatio ) )

	; debug
if ( T_Glob_Speech_Debug >= 2 )
	MessageBox "npcMult %.3f pcMult %.3f" npcDisposition pcFatigueRatio
endif

		; swaying
set npcPower to ( ( npcSpeechcraft + 0.5*npcPersonality + 0.1*npcLuck ) * npcDisposition )
set pcPower to ( ( pcSpeechcraft + 0.5*pcPersonality + 0.1*pcLuck ) * pcFatigueRatio )
set T_Glob_Speech_Sway to ( pcPower / npcPower )
	; debug
if ( T_Glob_Speech_Debug >= 1 )
	MessageBox "npcPower %.3f 	pcPower %.3f 	T_Glob_Speech_Sway %.3f" 	npcPower 	pcPower 	T_Glob_Speech_Sway
endif

		; haggling
set npcPower to ( ( npcMercantile + 0.5*npcPersonality + 0.1*npcLuck ) * npcDisposition )
set pcPower to ( ( pcMercantile + 0.5*pcPersonality + 0.1*pcLuck ) * pcFatigueRatio )
set T_Glob_Speech_Haggle to ( pcPower / npcPower )
	; debug
if ( T_Glob_Speech_Debug >= 1 )
	MessageBox "npcPower %.3f 	pcPower %.3f 	T_Glob_Speech_Haggle %.3f" 	npcPower 	pcPower 	T_Glob_Speech_Haggle
endif

		; debating
set npcPower to ( ( 0.5*npcSpeechcraft + npcIntelligence + 0.1*npcLuck ) * npcDisposition )
set pcPower to ( ( 0.5*pcSpeechcraft + pcIntelligence + 0.1*pcLuck ) * pcFatigueRatio )
set T_Glob_Speech_Debate to ( pcPower / npcPower )
	; debug
if ( T_Glob_Speech_Debug >= 1 )
	MessageBox "npcPower %.3f 	pcPower %.3f 	T_Glob_Speech_Debate %.3f" 	npcPower 	pcPower 	T_Glob_Speech_Debate
endif

stopScript T_ScSpeech_SkillCheck

End

Begin T_ScTrans_WereCheck

;should be expanded when new strains of disease are added to data
;i mean mostly models since it's one of the harder things to do atm

short currentDay
short dayCount
short hasDisease
short state

;T_Glob_WereInfected is additional global indicating player is not BM werewolf
;0 = Normal, 1 = Wereboar, 2 = Werewolf, etc.

;PCWerewolf, 0 = Normal, 1 = Werewolf, -1 = Cured

if ( PCVampire == 1 ) ;MAKE SURE PC CAN'T BE VAMP AND WERE
	return
endif

if ( state == -1 )
	return
endif

if ( state == 10 )
	set state to -1
	if ( T_Glob_WereInfected == 1 )
		StartScript T_ScTrans_WereboarPC
	elseif ( T_Glob_WereInfected == 2 )
		StartScript T_ScTrans_WerewolfPC
	endif
	set PCWerewolf to 1
endif

if ( PCWerewolf != 0 )
	stopScript T_ScTrans_WereCheck 	;stop this script if they become a shifter or cured
	return
endif

if ( player->GetSpell "T_Dis_WereboarBlood" == 1 )
	if ( hasDisease == 0 )
		set hasDisease to 1
		set currentDay to Day
		set T_Glob_WereInfected to 1
	endif
elseif ( player->GetSpell "T_Dis_WerewolfBlood" == 1)
	if ( hasDisease == 0 )
		set hasDisease to 1
		set currentDay to Day
		set T_Glob_WereInfected to 2
	endif
else
	if ( hasDisease == 1 )		;they had it at one point, but don't anymore
		set hasDisease to 0
		set currentDay to 0
		set dayCount to 0
		set T_Glob_WereInfected to 0
	endif
endif

if ( hasDisease == 1 )			;has disease will get set back to 0 before here if they cured it

	if ( currentDay != day )	;the day has changed, so up the count
		set dayCount to dayCount + 1
		set currentDay to Day
	endif

	if ( dayCount >= 3 )	;goes over 3 days
		set state to 10
	endif

else
	stopScript T_ScTrans_WereCheck 	;stop this script if there is no desease
endif

End

begin T_ScVamp_Baluath_Cure

;Global script that only runs when player becomes vampire
;---
;Runs until player is cured via vanilla Vampire_Cure_PC script
;Vampire_Cure_PC sets PCVampire to -1 when cured
;Removes this clan's vampire bonuses and ends Dreams script

;START Baluath specific stuff

float timer
short ashStorm

;Applies ash storm benefits
;Checks every second for performance
;Uses GetWindSpeed to detect fake exteriors
set timer to ( timer + GetSecondsPassed )
if ( timer > 1 )
	set timer to 0
	if ( ashStorm )
		set ashStorm to 0
	endif
	if ( GetWindSpeed )
		if ( GetCurrentWeather >= 6 ) ;ash
			if ( GetCurrentWeather <= 7 ) ;blight
				set ashStorm to 1
			endif
		endif
	endif
	if ( ashStorm )
		if ( player->GetSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_Ash" == 0 )
			player->AddSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_Ash"
			player->AddSpell "T_Vamp_Sp_Baluath_Ash"
			if ( player->GetSpell "vampire sun damage" )	; Handle Namira's Shroud
				player->AddSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_SunDmg"
				player->RemoveSpell "vampire sun damage"
			endif
		endif
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_Ash" )
		player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_Ash"
		player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Sp_Baluath_Ash"
		if ( player->GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_SunDmg )	; Handle Namira's Shroud
			player->AddSpell "vampire sun damage"
			player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_SunDmg"
		endif
	endif
endif

;END Baluath specific stuff

if ( PCVampire != -1 )
    Return
endif

Player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath"
Player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_Ash"
Player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Sp_Baluath_Ash"
Player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_SunDmg"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Attributes"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Skills"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Immunities"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Touch"

if ( GetPCRank T_Mw_Clan_Baluath >= 0 )
	PCExpell T_Mw_Clan_Baluath
endif

StopScript "vampdreamScript"
StopScript "T_ScVamp_Baluath_Cure"

end

begin T_ScVamp_Baluath_PC

;Global script that runs when player is infected
;
;Gives player 3 days to cure infection before giving 
;player this clan's vampirism
;
;Script stops if player becomes vampire or werewolf 
;before 3 days

short dayHold
short doMath
short state
short stopTransform

;vanilla global DaysPassed
;vanilla global PCVampire
;Tamriel_Data global T_Glob_PorphyricInfected

;-------------------------------------------------
; Check whether player has already transformed via
; another disease
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( PCVampire != 0 )
    set stopTransform to 1
elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
    set stopTransform to 1
endif

;-------------------------------------------------
; Check whether 3 days have passed since infection
; Must be above MenuMode check to allow WakeupPC
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( state == 1 )
    set doMath to ( DaysPassed - dayHold )

    if ( doMath < 3 )
        Return
    elseif ( GetPCSleep )
        set state to 2
        WakeupPC
    endif
endif

if ( MenuMode )
    Return
endif

;-------------------------------------------------
; Player cured themselves before 3 days elapsed so 
; reset T_D global and stop the script
; OR
; Player has disease so set T_D global to clan 
; number and start the 3 day clock
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( player->GetSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Baluath != 1 )
    set stopTransform to 1
elseif ( state == 0 )
    set T_Glob_PorphyricInfected to 100
    set state to 1
    set dayHold to DaysPassed
    Return
endif

;-------------------------------------------------
; Stop script if player cures disease or becomes 
; vampire or werewolf before 3 days pass
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( stopTransform == 1 )
    set T_Glob_PorphyricInfected to 0
    set dayHold to 0
    set doMath to 0
    set state to 0
    set stopTransform to 0
    StopScript T_ScVamp_Baluath_PC
    Return
endif

;-------------------------------------------------
; Player has disease and 3 days have passed so
; transform the player, remove the disease, and 
; give vampire abilities
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( state == 2 )
    MessageBox "I dreamt of a blond maiden. I drew near, and saw she was crying, but her tears were red as blood. I touched her tears and tasted them, and they were wonderfully salty, sharp with spice and savor. But the maiden's face had changed, her skin grey-white, and red tears dripped from her lips, and her hair had turned black, and wreathed her head like twining snakes. I was afraid, but could not run. I screamed, and then I woke, heart pounding, cramped and aching.", "Ok"

    player->RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Baluath
    player->AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Attributes"
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Skills"
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Immunities"
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Touch"

    set T_Glob_PorphyricInfected to 0
    set PCVampire to 1
    set VampClan to 100

    StartScript vampdreamScript
    StartScript T_ScVamp_Baluath_Cure
    StopScript T_ScVamp_Baluath_PC
endif

end

begin T_ScVamp_Khulari_NPC

;Should check for all vanilla and T_D province mod infection
;---
;Checks run on cellchange and then constantly if applicable
;No need for always-running global scripts like vanilla

short Sky_Hold
short Sky_Control
short Sky_ControlQ
short NoLore

short NoHello
short NoFlee
short NoIdle
short NoIntruder
short NoThief

short checkBlood
short doOnce
short state

short T_Local_Vampire
short T_Local_NPC
short T_Local_NoLore
short T_Local_Khajiit

;Vanilla global PCVampire
;Vanilla global PCWerewolf
;Tamriel_Data global T_Glob_PorphyricInfected

;-----------------------------------------------
; Drop vampire dust on death like vanilla
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( OnDeath )
	AddItem "ingred_vampire_dust_01" 1
endif

;-----------------------------------------------
; Check player infection/vampire status
;-----------------------------------------------

if ( CellChanged )
	set checkBlood to 0
	set state to 0

	if ( T_Glob_PorphyricInfected )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Quarra" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Aundae" )
	elseif ( player->GetSpell "Vampire Blood Berne" )
	elseif ( PCVampire != 0 )
	elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
	else
		;Player isn't infected/vampire/cured vampire/werewolf
		set checkBlood to 1
	endif
endif

if ( MenuMode )
	return
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was not infected before changing cell,
; so constantly check for infection and then run 
; this clan's specific global script
;------------------------------------------------

if ( checkBlood )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects "T_Vamp_Dis_Khulari" )
		if ( ScriptRunning "T_ScVamp_Khulari_PC" != 1 )
			StartScript "T_ScVamp_Khulari_PC"
		endif
	endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Player was infected/vampire before changing cell,
; so check whether player is in an enemy clan
;------------------------------------------------

elseif ( state != 1 )
	if ( VampClan == 200 )
		SetFight 30	;Player is a friendly vampire
	else
		SetFight 90	;Player is an enemy vampire
	endif

	set state to 1
endif

;------------------------------------------------
; Apply vampire spells/abilities to this NPC once
;------------------------------------------------

if ( doOnce == 0 )
	AddSpell "T_Vamp_Dis_Khulari"
	AddSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Khulari"
	AddSpell "Vampire Attributes"
	AddSpell "Vampire Skills"
	AddSpell "Vampire Immunities"
	AddSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
	AddSpell "Vampire Touch"
	ModRestoration 75
	;set province-specific location variable for dialogue here
	set doOnce to 1
	set T_Local_Khajiit to -1

	if ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Cathay-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Dagi-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Ohmes-raht" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Suthay" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "T_Els_Tojay" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	elseif ( GetRace "Khajiit" )
		set T_Local_Khajiit to 1
	endif
endif

begin T_ScVamp_Khulari_PC

;Global script that runs when player is infected
;
;Gives player 3 days to cure infection before giving 
;player this clan's vampirism
;
;Script stops if player becomes vampire or werewolf 
;before 3 days

short dayHold
short doMath
short state
short stopTransform

;vanilla global DaysPassed
;vanilla global PCVampire
;Tamriel_Data global T_Glob_PorphyricInfected

;-------------------------------------------------
; Check whether player has already transformed via
; another disease
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( PCVampire != 0 )
    set stopTransform to 1
elseif ( PCWerewolf == 1 )
    set stopTransform to 1
endif

;-------------------------------------------------
; Check whether 3 days have passed since infection
; Must be above MenuMode check to allow WakeupPC
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( state == 1 )
    set doMath to ( DaysPassed - dayHold )

    if ( doMath < 3 )
        Return
    elseif ( GetPCSleep )
        set state to 2
        WakeupPC
    endif
endif

if ( MenuMode )
    Return
endif

;-------------------------------------------------
; Player cured themselves before 3 days elapsed so 
; reset T_D global and stop the script
; OR
; Player has disease so set T_D global to clan 
; number and start the 3 day clock
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( player->GetSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Khulari != 1 )
    set stopTransform to 1
elseif ( state == 0 )
    set T_Glob_PorphyricInfected to 200
    set state to 1
    set dayHold to DaysPassed
    Return
endif

;-------------------------------------------------
; Stop script if player cures disease or becomes 
; vampire or werewolf before 3 days pass
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( stopTransform == 1 )
    set T_Glob_PorphyricInfected to 0
    set dayHold to 0
    set doMath to 0
    set state to 0
    set stopTransform to 0
    StopScript T_ScVamp_Khulari_PC
    Return
endif

;-------------------------------------------------
; Player has disease and 3 days have passed so
; transform the player, remove the disease, and 
; give vampire abilities
;-------------------------------------------------

if ( state == 2 )
    MessageBox "I dreamt of a blond maiden. I drew near, and saw she was crying, but her tears were red as blood. I touched her tears and tasted them, and they were wonderfully salty, sharp with spice and savor. But the maiden's face had changed, her skin grey-white, and red tears dripped from her lips, and her hair had turned black, and wreathed her head like twining snakes. I was afraid, but could not run. I screamed, and then I woke, heart pounding, cramped and aching.", "Ok"

    player->RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Dis_Khulari
    player->AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Khulari
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Attributes"
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Skills"
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Immunities"
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
    player->AddSpell "Vampire Touch"

    set T_Glob_PorphyricInfected to 0
    set PCVampire to 1
    set VampClan to 200

    StartScript T_ScVamp_Dreams_Sky
    StartScript T_ScVamp_Khulari_Cure
    StopScript T_ScVamp_Khulari_PC
endif

end

begin T_ScVamp_Order_Cure

;Global script that only runs when player becomes vampire
;---
;Runs until player is cured via vanilla Vampire_Cure_PC script
;Vampire_Cure_PC sets PCVampire to -1 when cured
;Removes this clan's vampire bonuses and ends Dreams script

float cost
short state

if ( MenuMode == 0 )
	if ( player->GetSpellEffects T_Vamp_Sp_Order_Disguise )
		player->RemoveSpellEffects T_Vamp_Sp_Order_Disguise
		if ( player->GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise ) ; toggle disguise off
			player->RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
			if ( player->GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Disguise == 0 ) ; handle Namira's Shroud
				player->AddSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
			endif
		else ; toggle disguise on
			player->AddSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
			player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
			set state to 1
		endif
	elseif ( state )
		player->ModCurrentHealth -20
		set state to 0
	endif
	if ( player->GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise )
		set cost to ( player->GetIllusion )
		set cost to ( -15 / ( 50 + cost ) )
		set cost to ( cost * GetSecondsPassed )
		player->ModCurrentMagicka cost
		if ( player->GetMagicka > 0 )
			return
		endif
		player->RemoveSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise
		if ( player->GetSpell T_Vamp_Ab_Disguise == 0 ) ; handle Namira's Shroud
			player->AddSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
		endif
	endif
endif

if ( PCVampire != -1 )
    Return
endif

Player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Order"
Player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise"
Player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Sp_Order_Disguise"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Attributes"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Skills"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Immunities"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Sun Damage"
Player->RemoveSpell "Vampire Touch"

StopScript "T_ScVamp_Dreams_Cyr"
StopScript "T_ScVamp_Order_Cure"

end

Begin T_ScVamp_RemoveSunDamage

;This script is called from various other scripts in PTR for the purpose
; of removing the sun damage abilities from vampires temporarily
;Covers all special logic needed for each of the T_D clans

; 1 = try to remove sun damage spell
; 0 = try to add a sun damage spell
;global T_Glob_VampDamageRemove

; 1 = Vampyrum Order disguise
short control

;account for Namiras Shroud
if ( player->HasItemEquipped T_Dae_UNI_RobeShroud )
	StopScript T_ScVamp_RemoveSunDamage
	return
endif

;check if the player is Baluath currently in an ashstorm
if ( player->GetSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Baluath_SunDmg" )
	StopScript T_ScVamp_RemoveSunDamage
	return
endif

;try to remove sun damage effects
if ( T_Glob_VampDamageRemove )
	;check if the player is wearing the Order bloodline disguise
	if ( player->GetSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Order" )
		if ( player->GetSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise" )
			set control to 1
			player->RemoveSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise"
		endif
	endif
	
	if ( player->GetSpell "vampire sun damage" )
		player->RemoveSpell "vampire sun damage"
	endif
else
	if ( control == 1 )
		set control to 0
		player->AddSpell "T_Vamp_Ab_Order_Disguise"
	else
		player->AddSpell "vampire sun damage"
	endif
endif

StopScript T_ScVamp_RemoveSunDamage

End
